  • Long-Term Care Insurance: In partnership with Genworth Financial, Penn offers faculty and staff (and your eligible family members) long-term care insurance to help you cover some of the costs of long-term care services received at home, in the community or in a nursing facility. If you apply when you’re newly hired, you won’t have to provide proof of good health or be subject to underwriting requirements. Eligible family members must always provide proof of good health and are subject to underwriting.

  • Wellness and Work-life Resources: Penn is committed to supporting our faculty and staff as they balance the competing demands of work and personal life. That’s why we offer a wide variety of programs and resources to help you care for your health, your family, and your work-life balance.

  • Professional and Personal Development: Penn provides an array of resources to help you advance yourself personally and professionally.

  • University Resources: As a member of the Penn community, you have access to a wide range of University resources as well as cultural and recreational activities. Take advantage of the University’s libraries and athletic facilities, or visit our arboretum and art galleries. There’s always something going on at Penn, whether it’s a new exhibit at the Penn Museum, the latest music or theater presentation at the Annenberg Center, or the Penn Relays at Franklin Field to name just a few examples. As a member of the Penn community, you’re right in the middle of the excitement—and you and your family can enjoy many of these activities for free.

  • Discounts and Special Services: From arts and entertainment to transportation and mortgages, you'll find great deals for University faculty and staff. Not only do Penn arts and cultural centers and museums offer free and discounted admission and memberships to faculty and staff. You can also enjoy substantial savings on other goods and services such as new cars from Ford and General Motors, cellular phone service plans, movie tickets, and admission to theme parks.

  • Flexible Work Hours: Flexible work options offer creative approaches for completing work while promoting balance between work and personal commitments. These approaches involve use of non-traditional work hours, locations, and/or job structures.

  • Penn Home Ownership Services: Penn offers a forgivable loan for eligible employees interested in buying a home or currently residing in West Philadelphia, which can be used for closing costs or home improvements.

  • Adoption Assistance: Penn will reimburse eligible employees on qualified expenses in connection with the legal adoption of an eligible child, such as travel or court fees, for up to two adoptions in your household.

​

To learn more, please visit: https://www.hr.upenn.edu/PennHR/benefits-pay

title: Finance Administrator
description:
Finance Administrator

Part-time (50-60%, 2.5-3 days per week)

What is Rojo all about?

Rojo Integrations helps enterprises transform integration into a strategic advantage. We connect systems, processes, and people through AI-driven integration and intelligent automation - creating seamless digital ecosystems that are agile, scalable, and built for growth. From strategy and consultancy to managed services and integration software, Rojo delivers end-to-end solutions that simplify complex enterprise landscapes and give businesses real-time visibility and control over critical processes.

With deep SAP expertise and strategic partnerships with SAP, Coupa, Solace, SnapLogic, and Splunk, Rojo supports global enterprises from offices in the Netherlands, Spain, and India. Trusted by global Bluechip companies such as Siemens, AkzoNobel and EPS, we deliver tailored services to meet unique business needs.

We don’t just connect systems; we ignite greatness in every integration.

About the Role

Rojo Integrations is growing fast, fuelled by increasing market opportunities and continuously progressing positive business results. Do you want to become part of the Rojo success story? Here's your chance.

As Finance Administrator, based in the Breukelen, Netherlands, you will play a key role in the day-to-day financial administration of the organisation. You will process debtor and creditor administration, handle invoicing and bank bookings, support monthly closing and reporting, and contribute to payroll processing. This is a part-time role at 50-60% (2.5 to 3 days per week), offering the flexibility to combine this position with other commitments while still making a meaningful contribution to the Finance team.

Key Responsibilities

- Financial Administration: Processing debtor and creditor administration; performing bank bookings and accounting corrections.

- Invoice Processing: Processing purchase and cost invoices, employee declarations, bank mutations, and salary journals for multiple business entities.

- Reporting: Preparing financial prognoses, liquidity budgets, cashflow statements, and corporate finance reports.

- Monthly Closing: Preparing monthly overviews and processing monthly invoicing.

- Payroll Support: Supporting salary journal processing and liaising with payroll providers.

- Manager Support: Supporting the Finance Manager and department managers with financial data and ad-hoc requests.

What do you need to succeed?

- 3-5 years of demonstrable accounting/bookkeeping experience

- Relevant educational background in Finance, Accounting, or a related field (MBO-4, HBO, or equivalent qualification)

- Solid knowledge of Dutch administration, tax and accounting rules

- Experience with accounting software (e.g. Exact, Twinfield)

- Good working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Microsoft Excel, Word, etc.

- Analytical and numerically accurate - precise and detail-oriented

- Organised and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

- Proactive, caring, and patient working style

- Ability to work independently and in a team

- Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is an advantage

- Dutch language proficiency is a must; good command of English (written and spoken) is required

Working Relationships

- Finance Manager

- Department managers

- External accountants and auditors

- Payroll provider

- Tax authorities

- Suppliers and vendors

Information Security & Quality Responsibilities

As part of their role, every Rojo employee is expected to:

- Be aware of and act in accordance with Rojo's Information Security & Quality Management System, including all applicable policies and procedures.

- Complete mandatory information security and quality awareness training as required by Rojo's operational plan.

- Protect information in line with Rojo's Information Classification & Data Handling Policy, ensuring that confidential, restricted, or internal information is not disclosed to unauthorised parties.

- Report information security incidents, suspected breaches, or quality non-conformities promptly via the designated reporting channel (JIRA service desk), in line with the Incident Management Policy.

- Support Rojo's continuous improvement objectives by contributing to the identification and reporting of risks, issues, and improvement opportunities within their area of work.

- Comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and contractual obligations relevant to their role, including data protection legislation (GDPR).

What do we offer?

- All the resources you need to support your professional development (e.g. training, mentoring, learning budget)

- A visible role with opportunity to shape your role and contributions, room for developing your own initiatives to streamline our different financial processes.

- A global, inclusive and diverse working climate within a world conscious organisation, with bright, ambitious and positively minded people

- A hybrid working environment; we offer the possibility to work from our office(s)/home or remotely

We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we’re committed to creating a place where everyone can thrive.

We are looking forward to receiving your application, but please note that only applicants with an EU citizenship or a valid residency/work permit will be considered for this role.

Great people rarely fit completely into job descriptions.

If you’re curious, driven, and excited by what we’re building, apply - even if your experience doesn’t match every bullet point.

Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger teams, and better outcomes for our customers.

Come build with us.

title: Physician Assistant-QHC-12600-008
description:
Under the general supervision of a licensed and Board Certified / eligible Physician, evaluates and treats patients having medical problems. Performs routine histories and physical examinations; performs and/or interprets diagnostic tests and/or procedures as detailed in the department specific scope of practice. Participates in teaching and quality assurance activities with other members of the clinical department. Delivers direct patient care. Writes appropriately authorized prescriptions. Writes appropriately authorized prescriptions including controlled substances. 4. Performs other duties pursuant to clinical responsibility, such as arranging follow-up for patients, obtaining informed consent from patient for procedures they are credentialed to perform, recalling patients for further evaluation and treatment, escorting patients, when necessary, to other areas of the hospital, etc. Informs patients of necessary post-discharge instructions as required. Makes appropriate entries in patients charts.

5. Completes and documents participation in continuing medical education required of Physician Assistants in order to meet requirements for certification, including assigned lectures and conferences.

6. Performs related duties as required professionally or at the request of the Supervising Physician, Director of Service and/or Supervising Physician Assistant.

7. Performs related duties as required professionally or at the request of the Supervising Physician, Director of Service and/or Supervising Physician Assistant.

-Graduation from an approved Physician Assistant Program.

-Licensure issued by NYS.

-Certification by NCCPA and ACLS/BLS.PALS in some areas of patient care.

-Intermediate computer skills in Word, Excel.

-High level of analytical ability.

The Mount Sinai Health System (MSHS) provides salary ranges that comply with the New York City Law on Salary Transparency in Job Advertisements. The salary range for the role is $68.52 - $91.36 Hourly. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and operational need. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentive, differential pay or other forms of compensation or benefits.

title: Web3 Security Senior Operations Specialist
description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze complex Web3 security cases and extract recurring attack patterns to build and maintain comprehensive SOPs.

  • Proactively identify gaps in current operation workflows and propose systematic improvements to enhance the team's overall efficiency.

  • Partner with AI agents to crystallize security insights into a high-quality knowledge base, improve team’s collective intelligence and operational speed.

  • Stay ahead of emerging fraud techniques and evolving Web3 product logic, translating these trends into actionable defense strategies for the team.

  • Work closely with engineering and strategy teams to transform manual analysis into automated detection rules.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in anti-fraud, risk control, or blockchain-related fields; proven ability to handle complex problems through a structured and systematic approach.

  • Excellent at deconstructing complicated scams or technical exploits into clear, logical steps. Deep coding skills are not required, but you must have a sharp mind for technical logic and user-flow sequences.

  • A fast learner with a strong interest in AI. You should understand how to use and prime AI tools to scale your own output and improve the team's data quality.

  • Capable of writing clear, professional documentation and communicating effectively in a global team environment.

  • Familiarity with DeFi, Wallet products, and the general Web3 ecosystem's unique security challenges.

Why Binance
• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure

• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

skills.title: Projektleder søges til Innovation og Forsyningsplanlægning
skills.description:
Projektleder søges til Innovation og Forsyningsplanlægning

Vil du være med til at nedbringe uvedkommende vand og overløb fra vores spildevandssystem på Bornholm? Spildevand er en del af den helt grundlæggende infrastruktur, og det er afgørende for vores sundhed, vores natur og miljø. På en ø som Bornholm handler det i høj grad også om det vand, der omgiver os, og vi har en stor opgave i at sikre, at spildevandssystemet er klar til fremtidig belastning, at vi får genanvendt ressourcerne bedst muligt, og at vi får sikret et bedre vandmiljø på og rundt om øen.

Vi leder lige nu efter en projektleder, som vil lede projektet "Nedbringelse af uvedkommende vand og overløb", der er en del af arbejdet med fremtidens spildevandsstruktur. Vi leder efter dig, som er en fagligt stærk og ambitiøs projektleder, og samtidig har en indsigt og teknisk forståelse af spildevand. Du kan både lede projekter, skabe overblik og have et tæt samarbejde med driften om praktiske løsninger. Du brænder for at skabe løsninger der bidrager til en mere effektiv drift, og samtidig skaber positive effekter i den bornholmske natur, der tilsammen medvirker til at vi opfylder vores vision om udviklingen af et bæredygtigt Bornholm.

Din rolle

I afdelingen arbejder vi både med den langsigtede forsyningsudvikling og med innovationsprojekter, hvor vi udvikler og demonstrerer ny energi-, fjernvarme-, spildevands- og vandrensningsteknologi. Du kommer til at arbejde sammen med 17 projektledere og faglige specialister, der i fællesskab driver 3 strategiske udviklingsprogrammer og 15 innovationsprojekter. Sammen realiserer vi BEOFs strategiske ambitioner til konkrete resultater der kommer Bornholm og bornholmerne til gavn.

I dit projekt vil du komme til at arbejde med en plan for måling af overløb, nedbringe overløb ved regn-hændelser, opspore og nedbringe uvedkommende vand, samt bidrage i koordineringen af de planlagte renoveringer af overløbsbygværker. Du skal derfor kunne omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til praktiske løsninger, og kunne samarbejde tæt med driften og eksterne leverandører ved f.eks. opsætning af måleudstyr.

I alle projekter og programmer i afdelingen arbejder en projektorganisation sammen som et team, og du får derfor god støtte og samarbejde med både tekniske projektledere, specialister og fagligt stærke driftsfolk. Erfaring fra branchen er en fordel.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • Projektledelse i samarbejde med projektorganisation.
  • Udarbejdelse af kommissorie, projektplan, risikoanalyse, interessentanalyse etc.
  • Styre alle processer omkring projektet og sikre allokering af de rigtige personer på de rigtige tidspunkter.
  • Bidrage med viden og kompetencer til andre innovationsprojekter i teamet.
  • Sikre at værdiskabelsen i projektet forankres i Bornholms Energi og Forsyning, gennem forsyningsudvikling og samarbejde med kollegaer fra andre afdelinger.
  • Deltage i udarbejdelsen af ansøgninger på nye innovationsprojekter, der understøtter vores strategiske mål og medvirker til udviklingen af et bæredygtigt Bornholm.
Din baggrund

I rollen som projektleder i Innovation og Forsyningsplanlægning kommer du til at lede projekter med komplekse problemstillinger og med mange interessenter. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du har et godt overblik og er vant til at uddelegere opgaver til din projektorganisation. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har en teknisk baggrund og du kommer fra en lignende stilling med projektledelse eller på anden vis, har opnået stor faglighed inden for projektledelse.

Dine personlige kvalifikationer:

  • En uddannelse som Ingeniør, Maskinmester, Naturvidenskabelig kandidat, eller lignende.
  • Erfaring med projektledelse og koordinering af komplekse projekter i samarbejde med forskellige aktører.
  • Du er positiv, udadvendt og søger aktivt samarbejdet for at opnå fælles mål.
  • Et personligt drive og elsker at drive projekter i mål.
  • Du kan tænke ud af boksen, og du kan være i, at processer forandrer sig undervejs.
  • Du kan skabe struktur og have det store overblik, men du har også sans for detaljer.
  • Du kan formulere dig på skrift og i tale - på dansk såvel som engelsk.
  • Du er praktisk anlagt og forstår hvordan driftssystemer fungerer.
Du tilbydes

Du tilbydes et spændende job i en ambitiøs virksomhed i konstant udvikling. Bornholms Energi & Forsyning er en af de væsentligste aktører i Bornholms Regions Kommunes ambition om, at øen i 2040 skal være et nul-udledningssamfund baseret på bæredygtig og vedvarende energi.

Gennem vores samarbejde med danske og internationale virksomheder og universiteter får du adgang til et stort netværk af viden, mulighed for rejseaktiviteter og stejle læringskurver.

Du får dygtige og supersociale kollegaer, der arbejder med projektledelse og innovation på et højt fagligt niveau, som glæder sig til mandag morgen for at høre, hvad du har lavet i weekenden.

Derudover tilbydes du løn efter kvalifikationer, pensionsordning og diverse personalegoder. Du vil få base i Rønne i Bornholms Energi & Forsynings Afdeling "Innovation og Forsyningsplanlægning".

Sådan søger du

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling, med start snarest muligt, eller senest 1. november 2026.

Du søger stillingen ved at trykke på "Søg stillingen" på denne side, og sende en ansøgning senest d. 23.8.2026, der skal bestå af maksimalt 1 sides motiveret ansøgning og maksimalt 2 siders CV.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes at blive afholdt i uge 37 og 38.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan du få hos: Afdelingsleder for Innovation og Forsyningsplanlægning, Maria Hach på telefon 40 24 04 93 eller via e-mail mah@beof.dk

skills.title: Electromechanical
skills.description:
Apply today to be an Electromechanical Technician with one of the most innovative and trusted packaging companies in the world. Printpack is seeking a qualified candidate to fill the position of Electromechanical Technician for the Converting plant in Grand Prairie, TX. The Electromechanical Technician installs, maintains, and repairs complex electrical and mechanical manufacturing equipment while ensuring optimal performance and safety standards. Working independently in a fast-paced environment, this position requires technical expertise to manage multiple priorities, minimize downtime, and support production goals through continuous improvement initiatives. Success in this role demands strong judgment, efficient troubleshooting skills, and commitment to maintaining the highest standards of quality and safety. This is a 3/2 Night Shift position from 7pm-7am. Sun/Wed/Thurs - Mon/Tues/Fri/Sat.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Performs comprehensive electrical and mechanical troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex manufacturing equipment, including 24V analog/digital circuitry, VFDs, PLCs, and automated systems

  • Executes preventive maintenance programs through scheduled inspections, calibrations, and repairs while documenting all activities in computerized maintenance systems

  • Interprets and works from electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, hydraulic/pneumatic layouts, and technical documentation to diagnose and repair equipment

  • Tests and troubleshoots electrical systems using multi-meters, ammeters, and diagnostic equipment

  • Installs, wires, and verifies operation of 3-phase, single-phase, and DC motors according to electrical schematics

  • Implements and strictly follows safety protocols, including LockOut/TagOut procedures and emergency response procedures

  • Performs rigging and lifting operations for heavy equipment components while following safety requirements

  • Maintains accurate documentation of repairs, parts usage, and preventive maintenance activities

  • Coordinates maintenance activities with production schedules and shift leadership to minimize downtime

  • Provides technical training and support to operators on equipment operation and basic maintenance

  • Participates in continuous improvement initiatives and engineering projects

  • Collaborates with team members, vendors, and contractors to support maintenance operations and equipment upgrades

Education & Experience:

  • Associate degree in Electromechanical Technology or equivalent experience preferred

  • 3+ years of industrial maintenance experience

Required Skills:

  • Proficiency in reading electrical schematics and mechanical blueprints

  • Strong troubleshooting skills for electrical and mechanical systems

  • Proficiency in computer-based maintenance systems

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Multi-skilled in all areas of industrial maintenance

  • Able to use precision measuring equipment such as calipers

  • Able to engage in a team working collaboratively as well as making repairs independently

  • Metalworking and welding skills are a plus

  • HVAC experience a plus

  • Prefer to have strong electrical skills including experience with PLCs and drives, troubleshooting control circuits

Additional Requirements:

  • Must be 18 years of age

  • Must pass pre-employment assessment

  • Drug screening required

  • Background check required

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Advanced knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems

  • Expertise in preventive maintenance practices

  • Proficiency in basic welding and fabrication techniques

  • Understanding of safety protocols and OSHA regulations

  • Hydraulic and pneumatic systems

  • PLCs and automated control systems

  • Three-phase and single-phase power systems

  • Motor controls and servo systems

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

  • Critical Reasoning and Decision Making

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills

  • Effective verbal and written communication

  • Root cause identification

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • Ability to train and mentor others

Physical Demands: The associate will be exposed to the manufacturing environment where hazards and requirements may include but are not limited to:

  • Ability to lift and move up to 50 pounds

  • Standing/walking for extended periods

  • Working in various positions (bending, kneeling, reaching)

  • Required to lift, bend, crouch, reach, twist, and crawl

  • Exposure to manufacturing environment (noise, heat, chemicals)

  • May require working in confined spaces

  • Required to work in high places

  • Required to ascend and descend ladders safely

  • Safely operate mobile equipment

  • Forklift Boom, scissor certification or ability to obtain certification

  • Ability to wear ARC flash equipment

  • Ability to wear respiratory protection as needed

  • Ability to wear required PPE (hearing protection, steel-toe shoes, safety glasses)

Work Conditions: The majority of tasks will be performed in a manufacturing setting with potential exposure to:

  • Noise levels above 85 dB

  • Operation of complex machinery

  • Solvents, fumes and inks

  • Concrete floors, roof areas

  • Working at heights, hot work

  • Works near energized and moving equipment

  • Variable Temperatures

  • Must be able to work flexible shifts

  • May require nights, weekends, and holidays

  • An additional $2.50/hr premium for NIGHT Shift only between the hours of 7pm-7am. Any hours worked outside of 7pm-7am will not receive the premium.

Internal Requirements:

  • Must demonstrate Core Values

  • Must be in good standing with no disciplinary action or attendance issues (No disciplinary action of Written or above)

  • Must have performer or higher rating in last review

  • Demonstrated sense of urgency in production recovery situations

skills.title: Performance Manager - Non contract
skills.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Performance Manager plays a critical role in driving financial, operational, and compliance performance across multiple regions. This role partners closely with regional and EMEA leadership to ensure alignment with strategic goals, foster continuous improvement, and deliver actionable insights through robust governance and analytics.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial & Operational Performance

  • Lead collaboration with regional leaders to identify, track, and accelerate Variable Contribution Margin (VCM) improvements.
  • Monitor financial performance across monthly, quarterly, and annual cycles; analyze variances and proactively assess risks.
  • Oversee operational performance against contractual deliverables, project milestones, and PMV (Performance Measurement & Verification) completion.
  • Support scenario analysis, business reviews, and deep-dives to enable data-driven decision-making.
  • Become fully conversant with P&L’s, drive continual improvement for the way the P&L’s are operated.

Governance & Service Operating Model

  • Track Service Operating Model metrics, ensuring consistent governance tool adoption and disciplined issue resolution.
  • Facilitate tiered governance routines and performance reviews, highlighting trends and areas requiring escalation.
  • Partner with functional leaders (e.g., Service Operations, EHS, Finance, HR) to standardize governance practices.

EHS & Compliance Performance

  • Monitor Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) KPIs, flag concerns, and drive corrective actions.
  • Promote a safety-first culture through cross-regional best practices and continuous improvement.
  • Integrate EHS performance into regional scorecards and governance reviews.

Insights, Reporting & Analytics

  • Own regional performance dashboards and trackers, ensuring data integrity and transparency.
  • Develop standardized reporting packs covering financial, operational, and EHS metrics.
  • Identify trends and improvement opportunities across performance domains.

Continuous Improvement & Best Practice

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement by identifying efficiency gains and standardizing processes.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to prioritize and monitor improvement initiatives.
  • Support capability building through coaching on performance tools and governance disciplines.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Act as a trusted advisor to regional and EMEA leadership, providing insights and recommendations.
  • Ensure consistent communication of performance results, risks, and opportunities.
  • Build strong relationships to drive alignment and joint ownership of outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Proven experience in capacity planning, workforce management, or service operations in a multinational environment.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience engaging with remote or cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficiency in workforce planning tools and scheduling systems.
  • Experience in service delivery or field operations is highly desirable.
  • Experience of P&L working is desirable
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

TRAVEL TIME REQUIRED

  • 25%

skills.title: Specialist, Settlement Services

skills.title: IERP Release Analyst
skills.description:
Integrated Enterprise Resource Planning (I-ERP) is an initiative designed to drive operational efficiency and material cost reduction by adopting industry leading practices for Finance and Procurement processes. This program will enable real-time insights and faster decision making, delivering an integrated solution with near real time data and drill down capabilities. I-ERP is the largest business transformation program at Ford with the goal to adopt Best-in-Class Industry standard processes in both Finance (Plan to Report - PTR) and Purchasing (Source to Pay - STP) organizations. SAP S4 is selected as the enabler and tool of choice for the program with functionality to be deployed in the next 3 years. This will provide efficiencies and valuable business insights to make the right strategic decisions.
This STP release analyst role is key to the Source to Pay space. Strong communication and relationship building skills are important. We work in a fast paced, Agile/Product Driven Organization (PDO) environment to deliver high quality solutions.

  • Play a role in defining and implementing a large-scale SAP S4 I-ERP program

  • Support forward thinking for future releases.

  • Lead tactical activities and support overall strategic program objectives.

  • Act as Single Point of Contact for STP Product Managers

  • Manage the EPICS/Sub Epics/Features for the Product Group

  • Continuously assess issues, risks and opportunities while assisting with resolution

  • Gather and Track metrics progress for the Product Group.

  • Support gathering and review of metrics to support Major releases as well as to track Production Releases like Release on Demand, Problem Records etc.

  • Support System of Delivery (SoD) quarterly Program Increment (PI) planning and facilitation of events – Logistics, breakout sessions, presentations, workshops, etc.

  • Prepare Product Teams for Program Increment (PI) planning events.

  • Support Product Teams in Source to Pay through Releases, Program Increments and Iterations, providing guidance on SoD processes.

  • Consolidate Product Line Iteration reviews into Product Group Iteration reviews and retros.

  • Coordinate, be accountable and ensure Product Teams are progressing, focusing on scope, timelines & release management.

  • Champion business cutover and coordinate Product Line related tasks within the Product Group

  • Support resolving PDO and Foundational related dependencies with Product Managers

  • Remove blockers and impediments by ensuring teams are bringing issues to appropriate governance forums

Qualifications

  • Experience in areas of SAP Project management, Agile delivery, cross PDO Integration management

  • Knowledge of Agile processes, ceremonies and familiarity with SAP Source to Pay process and team structures.

  • Ability to collaborate with technical and business teams to support processes in a timely manner.

  • Previous experience supporting SAP Deployment projects and understanding of different release trains and dependencies.

  • Self-starter, desire for continuous improvement and strong attitude to learn the functional and technical aspects of the program.

Qualifications that are nice to have

  • Business Functional knowledge in Finance and Purchasing is a plus.

  • Experience working with third party vendors and service providers.

  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively with all levels in the Program.

  • Large scale Program experience

  • Demonstrated ability to multi-task and manage multiple priorities

  • Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical skills

  • Ability to influence and motivate people (This role works with ~400+ People)

  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment.

skills.title: Nuclear Technical Engineer
skills.description:
At Amentum, we're not just solving problems; we're engineering the future. Our team is driven by an unyielding commitment to innovation, integrity, and collaboration, tackling some of the most significant challenges in science, security, and sustainability. If you're passionate about making a real impact and want to be part of a community that values ethical excellence, this is the place where your ambition can thrive.

Here, we believe that success comes from continuously pushing boundaries and working together to deliver on our promises. We embrace challenges with confidence and are dedicated to creating a secure and vibrant future for all.

We’ll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow. We offer an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.

Work-life balance and flexibility is a key focus area for us. We’re happy to discuss hybrid, part-time and flexible working hours, patterns and locations to suit you and our business.

About the Opportunity

AT&R aims to provide world leading consultancy services across highly regulated industries.

Organised to be independent and free from conflict of interest, Assurance, Technology and Regulation (AT&R) provides a range of trusted, evidence-based, support services to ensure that systems, technologies, and processes are safe, effective, compliant, and future-ready, across 3 main areas:

Independent Assurance - We provide risk based, proportionate, independent oversight and assurance of whether a project, process, system or product meets defined standards, requirements, or expectations.

Research & Technology - We identify, define and execute programmes of Research and Technology to support the continued safe operation of some of the world’s most complex engineering challenges, including the UK Naval Nuclear Propulsion Programme.​

Independent Regulatory Support - A ring-fenced and independent organisation that supports regulators with assessments, audits, and guidance development.

With aspiration to grow, transform and evolve into new industries, locations and technologies.

About the Role

Our dynamic, customer facing Independent Nuclear Assurance (INA) team has been supporting the Ministry of Defence’s (MoD) naval nuclear propulsion programme for over sixty years. A number of exciting opportunities have arisen to join this diverse team of highly experienced staff who provide a key role in supporting the safe operation of the UK’s submarine fleet.

As a Nuclear Technical Engineer, you will help deliver independent assurance services to the MoD. This includes the provision of safety and technical advice for both current and future submarine Naval Reactor Plants (NRP), which involves working with a wide range of technical disciplines to provide balanced, proportionate and timely support.

We are seeking personnel who are passionate about nuclear safety and a desire to work in support of some of the most complex, challenging and important projects within the UK. This work requires a general knowledge of the design and operation of the NRP, safety case development and methodologies, and the ability to communicate effectively.

We are particularly interested in individuals with an aptitude and enthusiasm for mechanical systems and structural integrity to complement our existing team.

Comprehensive training can be provided across a range of technical areas to support development. Therefore, if you feel you meet most but not all the requirements, or work in civil nuclear/high hazard industries and are keen to take on a new challenge, we would like to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Providing authoritative Advice to the MoD through safety and technical assessments.

  • Supporting meetings with the MoD and their contractors.

  • Co-ordinating output across a range of relevant technical disciplines.

  • Working according to the best applicable safety, technical and regulatory standards against agreed programmes and budgets.

  • Working in accordance with business requirements for health, safety, environment, and security, as well as seeking continuous improvements in all aspects of work.

Here’s What You’ll Need

  • Degree (Level 6, minimum requirement) in science or engineering (or equivalent).

  • Membership of (or working towards) a professional institution is desirable.

  • Knowledge or operational experience of the Naval Reactor Plant is desirable.

  • Knowledge of safety cases (structures and function).

  • Familiarity with related documentation (NRPA NSMAs, DSA02-DNSR, ONR SAPs etc).

  • Clear, concise technical writing and communication skills.

  • This role will require security clearance; therefore, applicants should hold or be able to obtain security clearance in the UK.

Our Culture

Our values are built on a strong foundation of safety, integrity, and respect for every individual. People are at the heart of our mission, and we believe in supporting one another through a culture of care and collaboration.

We strive to create a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. Supporting mental wellbeing and fostering a sense of connection are essential to how we work.

When we embrace different perspectives and work together, we become more innovative, more agile, and more successful.

We partner with VERCIDA, for greater online accessibility please visit www.vercida.com to view and access our roles. As a Disability Confident employer, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for a vacancy. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role.

If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team.

La filiale SOCOTEC Power Services dédiée aux énergies décarbonées, regroupe les équipes spécialistes du Nucléaire et des énergies renouvelables (inspection règlementaire et qualité, assistance à maîtrise d’ouvrage, diagnostics structure / équipements, calculs, contrôles non destructifs, performance). SOCOTEC Power Services réalise près de 40M€ de chiffre d’affaires et regroupe plus de 400 collaborateurs experts, tous spécialistes d’une ou plusieurs énergies décarbonées :

Nucléaire : 350 personnes qui couvrent l’ensemble du territoire depuis nos bases de Guyancourt, Metz, Cherbourg, Bollene/Tricastin, Cadarache/Aix-en-Provence, Orléans. L’entité dispose des certifications des grands donneurs d’ordre (EDF, Framatome, Orano, CEA, General Electric, Siemens…) lui permettant d’exercer ses missions tout au long du cycle de vie des installations : de la conception à l’exploitation jusqu’au démantèlement.

En tant qu'Ingénieur Projets Génie Civil et dans le cadre de renforcement de nos équipes sur le projet Aval du Futur à Cherbourg en Cotentin, vous serez chargé(e) de :

  • Piloter des projets complexes dans le domaine du génie civil et de la construction
  • Réaliser des études techniques et des analyses de risques
  • Étudier l'organisation et les méthodes de construction des chantiers.
  • Élaborer les plans d'installation de chantier et participer au dimensionnement des installations provisoires.
  • Analyser les contraintes techniques, logistiques, environnementales et d'approvisionnement.
  • Réaliser des études de flux, de levage et des scénarios de construction afin d'optimiser les méthodes d'exécution.
  • Participer à l'établissement des plannings, des ratios de production et des estimations de ressources.
  • Assurer le suivi technique, le contrôle qualité et la conformité des travaux.
  • Conseiller les clients sur les aspects techniques, réglementaires et les bonnes pratiques du secteur.
  • Participer au développement de solutions innovantes visant à améliorer la performance et l'intégrité des ouvrages.
  • Exploiter les outils de modélisation 3D (BIM) pour la préparation et le suivi des projets.
  • Rédiger les notes techniques, rapports d'études et présenter les résultats aux équipes projet

Vous bénéficiez d'un salaire fixe (39 000 - 42 000 €) selon profil et des avantages suivants :

  • Véhicule de fonction à partir de 40€/mois
  • Statut cadre au forfait jour
  • Prime de participation + intéressement (2 300€ en 2025)
  • Panier repas à hauteur de 15 €
  • Plan d'épargne
  • Environnement de travail collaboratif
  • Un CSE aux avantages multiples (chèques vacances, carte cadeaux, …),
  • Un programme de cooptation attractif à partir de 1000€ par recrutement

Issus d’une formation initiale d’ingénieur en Génie Civil et disposant d’une expérience supérieure à 3 ans notamment sur des missions de conduites d’opérations de construction / méthode sur des grands projets, vos serez intégrer au sein d ‘un plateau multi-technique qui assure des missions de préparations d’un chantier de très grande envergure.

Processus de recrutement :

  • Echange RH (20/30 min)
  • Echange opérationnel avec le Directeur d’agence

Pourquoi rejoindre SOCOTEC ?

  • Nous vous accompagnons dans votre carrière en encourageant la promotion interne : chez SOCOTEC, 75% des postes d’encadrement sont pourvus par des promotions internes.
  • Parce que vous nous apportez votre expertise, nous vous aidons à la faire grandir et contribuons activement à votre développement professionnel grâce à des dispositifs de formation enrichis
  • Nous vous proposons un véhicule de qualité avec une participation avantageuse/compétitive.
  • Avec ses 150 agences en France, SOCOTEC offre des opportunités de mobilité géographique. Notre processus de recrutement et d’intégration a été optimisé pour offrir une expérience simple, digitale et complète à chaque candidat.

skills.title: Wir suchen Dich als Persönliche Assistenz (m/w/d) für Menschen mit Behinderung – Quereinsteiger*innen willkommen
skills.description:
Ein Job, der sich wie Freundschaft anfühlt!

Du bist zuverlässig, fühlst Dich mit Verantwortung verbunden und hast Lust, etwas wirklich Sinnvolles zu tun – Menschen mit Behinderung beim Lernen, Wohnen, Arbeiten und Leben zu begleiten? Du kannst Dir vorstellen, Teil eines zeitgemäßen, menschennahen Teams zu sein, das Assistenz nicht als Dienstleistung, sondern als echte Unterstützung im Alltag versteht?

Dann komm zu Ziemlich Beste Freunde und ergänze unser Team als Persönliche Assistenz.

So sieht Deine Tätigkeit aus:

  • Du bist behutsame Unterstützung für Menschen mit Behinderung – zu Hause, in der Schule, beim Job oder in der Freizeit

  • Du passt Dich ihrem individuellen Alltag an und wirst ein verlässlicher Fixpunkt in ihrem Tagesablauf

  • Du gleichst Einschränkungen auf praktische und respektvolle Weise aus, ohne Grenzen zu missachten oder zu übergehen

  • Deine Aufgaben können zum Beispiel sein: Unterstützung im Haushalt, Begleitung bei Terminen (Arzt, Therapie, Beratung), Hilfe in bildungsbezogenen oder beruflichen Kontexten und Aktivitäten in der Freizeit – von Kultur über Ausflüge bis hin zu Urlauben

  • Du bringst Dich mit Offenheit, Humor und Einfühlungsvermögen ein, statt nur „Dienst nach Vorschrift“ zu leisten

  • Dein Fokus liegt darauf, dass Dein Klient möglichst eigenständig entscheidet, eigene Wege geht und sich in seinem Alltag gesehen und angenommen fühlt

  • Auf diese Weise wirst Du für viele nicht nur eine Assistenzkraft, sondern eine wichtige Bezugsperson und ein echter ZIEMLICH BESTER FREUND

Das bringt Du mit:

  • Du bist herzlich und engagiert. Das Wohl von Menschen mit Behinderung liegt Dir wirklich am Herzen.

  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig, pünktlich und sorgfältig und nimmst Deine Aufgaben verantwortungsvoll wahr

  • Deine Art ist ruhig, offen und kommunikativ; Du gehst einfühlsam auf andere zu und bist hilfsbereit

  • Ein Führerschein der Klasse B ist von Vorteil, da Du gelegentlich auch mit dem Auto unterwegs bist.

  • Du bist flexibel und kannst auch außerhalb der „klassischen“ Bürozeiten einsetzbar sein – abends, an Wochenenden und an Feiertagen

  • Körperliche Tätigkeiten gehören für Dich zum Alltag dazu, und Du kannst Dich sprachlich sicher auf Deutsch verständigen

Selbstverständlich freuen wir uns auch über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung, die bei uns als Assistenz tätig sein möchten.

Dein Vorteile als Assistenzkraft von ZIEMLICH BESTE FREUNDE:

  • Keine Vorerfahrung oder Ausbildung für die Tätigkeit notwendig
  • Kein Stress, Druck oder Konkurrenzkampf bei der Arbeit
  • 1:1-Betreuung: Im Vergleich zu Pflegediensten arbeitest Du bei uns immer nur bei einem Klienten, sodass Dein Arbeitsalltag weniger gestresst ist
  • Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle: Bei uns gibt es keine klassische 40-Stunden-Woche. Deine Arbeitszeiten können stets mit uns abgestimmt und individuell an Deine Bedürfnisse angepasst werden
  • 2-tägige Arbeitswoche = Volles Gehalt = Maximale Freizeit: Aufgrund verschiedener Schichtdienste ist es möglich, dass Deine Arbeitswoche nur aus 2 Arbeitstagen (und 5 freien Tagen) besteht
  • Viele Prämien & Zuschläge: Nachtschicht-, Sonn- & Feiertagszuschläge sowie Prämien bei Backup-Diensten
  • Wir übernehmen Dein Job-Ticket
  • Du erhältst einen monatlichen Gutschein, den Du flexibel nach Deinen Bedürfnissen einsetzen kannst – zum Beispiel bei REWE, Netflix oder ARAL
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Erhöhung Deiner Rentenansprüche durch den Aufbau einer Zusatzrente über uns als Arbeitgeber (Entgeltumwandlung)
  • Regelmäßige Schulungen & Trainee-Programme zur Optimierung der Betreuungsleistung
  • Das Ziemlich Beste Team: Teamevents, cooles Ambiente, ein lockerer Umgang sowie vertrauensbasiertes Arbeiten
  • Wir haben keine klassische „Chef-Kultur“ – Wir legen stattdessen Wert auf flache Hierarchien und Mitbestimmungsrecht in unternehmerischen Entscheidungen, damit Du Deinen Arbeitsplatz so mitgestalten kannst, dass Du Dich maximal wohlfühlst
  • Wir versprechen Dir viel Humor und Spaß bei der Arbeit

skills.title: Project Manager, Development
skills.description:
Job Type:

Regular

Plains is an industry-leading transportation and midstream provider specializing in transportation, storage, processing and marketing solutions for crude oil. We own an extensive network of pipeline transportation, terminalling, storage and gathering assets in key oil producing basins and transportation corridors and at major market hubs in the United States and Canada. The company is headquartered in Houston, Texas.

We’re on the lookout for passionate self‑starters who thrive in fast‑moving, collaborative, and innovative environments.

Plains has an immediate opening for a Project Manager in our Midland, Texas office. Reporting to the Senior Manager, you will work closely with Plains’ business units to establish project scope, develop preliminary designs, cost estimates, schedules, risk registers, and execution plans for viable projects. You will provide technical consultation to project teams and Operations to ensure project planning reflects operational requirements, industry practices, and regulatory expectations. You will also support business functions and strategies that optimize the value of Plains’ assets. Some limited travel may be required.

The successful candidate will be eligible for company benefits including medical / dental / prescription/vision, 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other programs.

Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with Business Development and Execution to establish scope and scope alternatives for projects in the initial phase that meet customer needs.
  • Facilitate project planning sessions to solicit input from departments within Plains and incorporate that input into project scope and scope alternatives for estimates.
  • Develop unclassified estimates, associated risks, and schedule to support new business opportunities. Incorporate lessons learned into estimate development. Support Business Development in achieving a go/no go decision with executives.
  • Provide Class estimate development services to Expansion Projects Team. Solicit input from non‑technical teams and develop associated risk registers, schedules and basis of estimates. Review Class estimates and provide feedback.
  • Utilize Project Definition Rating Index (PDRI) on estimates to measure completeness of project scope definition.
  • Maintain project benchmarking database and assess cost and schedule trends. Translate into action items to ensure ongoing project competitiveness.
  • Perform contingency modeling on Class estimates and support use of escalation tool.
  • Maintain project portfolio prioritization model to support recommendations for projects that align with Plains’ strategic priorities.
  • Ensure project designs and constructed assets comply with regulatory requirements, specifications, and operating practices.
  • Scrutinize scope and design change requests to ensure validity, justification, and impact on EBITDA, reliability, and operations; obtain approvals for deviations.
  • Provide project services such as Project Lookbacks, Contingency & Escalation Modeling, and Construction Quality Management System (CQMS) session facilitation.
  • Develop and maintain Plains’ cost estimating practices and basis; establish industry benchmarks.

Qualifications:

  • Engineering degree in an applicable discipline; professional engineering designation and eligible for registration in Texas.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in pipeline and oil or gas processing, including design, construction, and project management
  • Familiarity with labor, safety, and environmental regulations; working knowledge of U.S. codes and standards for pipelines and hydrocarbon‑processing facilities.
  • Knowledge of AACE and PMI best practices in estimating and project management.
  • Knowledge of cost estimating systems, benchmarking tools, and risk modeling practices.
  • Strong leadership, decision‑making, conflict resolution, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Project and project scheduling tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize workload, and coordinate diverse stakeholders and contractors.
  • Cleared criminal history (background) check and satisfactory reference checks.
  • Compliance with company Drug & Alcohol Policy including pre‑employment testing.
  • Valid state driver’s license and driving record satisfactory to company and insurers.
  • Authorized to work in the U.S.; position not eligible for employment‑based visa sponsorship.

#Plains

At Plains, our employees are our most valuable asset. Hard work is rewarded with competitive compensation and a top-tier benefits program designed to keep our employees safe, healthy and happy. We work hard to deliver the best results to our stakeholders, and we also respect our employees' need for personal and family time, which is reflected in our benefits program.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, without regard to age, race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. skills.title: Channel Inside Sales Representative CSE & Baltics
skills.description:
At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people.

As an Channel Inside Sales Representative you will be responsible to develop, manage and communicate with the targeted resellers. You will proactively work as the single point of contact for the resellers to discuss projects, promos, new products, technical support requirements, marketing requirements, and other channel run rate concerns. You will work closely with the regional sales team and channel manager in developing the channel run rate business.

You will be part of a highly motivated and experienced team that will support you every step of the way. You will work in an autonomous environment, which emphasizes customer satisfaction, entrepreneurship, ownership and achieving results.

Key responsibilities:

Achieve the set targets by the business through account management;

  • Develop, manage and engage the assigned resellers in order to ensure that they achieve the set target; Coordinate and discuss with all stakeholders (e.g., distributor, distribution manager, channel manager, regional account managers) the requirements of the resellers and to ensure its closure and/or completion.
  • Become the go-to person for existing resellers by communicating them the sales programs and educating them about the company’s current and new products.
  • Create account growth plans for the top partners in your region
  • Present monthly during the Month Sales review the performance of the resellers in your region.

Customer Engagement

Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to understand their needs and offer tailored solutions as well as communicating to them about our sales programs/ promos or new products releases.

Pipeline Management & forecasting

Manage and follow reseller opportunities - present the offer advertising the value proposition of the solutions, own the sales process from lead to order.

Take over VPP account after 1st Buy

Reactivate dormant VPPs to promote Growth and retention

Follow up leads identified by Telemarketing, converting them to opportunities and own them until closure.

Sell add-ons to existing purchases (up/cross-sell) Contact customer to catch up on latest purchase(s) and offer add-ons

Prevent churn of partners with declining prognostic / reactivate churned partners Contact partner to understand reasons for decline/ churn. Offer incentive for reactivation.

Contribute to team-work and knowledge sharing inside the team and organization: manage and update the central Channel Run Rate database; prepare and generate reports and analysis; Manage and update CRM/VPP (Vertiv Partner Program) database; Regularly communicate and update to sales management.

Focus on self-growth and development: keep an open mind and learn from some of the best experts in the industry, participate in industry events and acquire knowledge of where the market is going, keep up to date with technical developments, participate in sales trainings and apply the knowledge in your day to day work.

Be innovative: bring your own ideas of improvements inside the team, look at each process and task with the goal of constantly improving it to bring more value to the customer, to you, the team and the organization.

Own their job: approach your daily work and customers with ethics, responsibility, discipline and ownership, knowing that everything you do has an impact on the customers, the company and your development. Sales activities, related administrative activities, reporting and your own development are all important and lead to your success in the role.

Support with:

  • Planning, implementation and analysis of promotions
  • By developing an understanding over time of the partner/reseller/ distributor behaviors, likes, dis-likes, trends and competitive channel landscape in their regions.
  • EOL and product launch activities
  • Invites and following up on webinars
  • Gather feedback from the market on our competitors
  • Raise and follow up issues to management level
  • Be aware of all pricing, promotions, actions, event within the sales team
  • Follow up rules, procedures and business ethic of VERTIV

Requirements:

Education: University degree in Sales & Marketing, commercial education or equivalent experience in telemarketing or sales

Experience:

- Field sales, Inside Sales, tele sales or sales assistant experience

- Strong verbal communication skills with a clear message (content and pronunciation)

- Expertise with Customer and/or Partner Relationship Management databases

Language skills: English: C2

Key competencies:

Communication: Demonstrates excellent listening and communication skills (written and verbal particularly over the phone) .

Relationship building: Understand, value and master personal relationship building in a remote (phone/email) environment .

Results Oriented: Revenue oriented, and can be counted on to consistently meet and exceed goals.

Teamwork: Organizes and directs effective teams at the cross-functional level that consistently achieve stated goals.

Initiative: Works independently and is highly motivated to initiate and accept new challenges.

Professionalism: Exhibits appropriate attributes in all aspects of performance and demeanor.

Taking Risk and Innovating, Entrepreneurial Spirit: You act decisively to attack difficult problems. You persevere in the face of problems. You take the lead in unpopular though necessary actions. You look for new tools and processes in order to deliver new approaches or products.

skills.title: Housekeeping Aide - FT
skills.location: Oak View Home - Waverly Hall, GA 31831
skills.description:
Join us at

Oak View Home

– a place where you’ll be valued, recognized and rewarded for the vital work you do each day. We’ll surround you with a strong team and leadership that supports every aspect of your life – both inside and outside of our centers. And you’ll get to practice your passion in a non-profit, mission-driven organization that’s known for the highest level of care in our communities

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Sweep, damp mop, and wet mop tile floors. May occasionally be required to spray buff, strip or wax floors, following center procedure, including the use of wet floor signs.
  • Report to supervisor any carpeted areas that need cleaning or spot removal.
  • Vacuum carpeted rooms as applicable.
  • Dust/damp clean surfaces in patient rooms (furniture, bed frames, windowsills, etc.) following center procedure, including the use of wet floor signs.
  • Empty trash cans, clean exterior, clean interior, and replace can liner with a clean one.
  • Clean bathroom sinks, fixtures, and toilets, following center procedure.
  • Clean glass surfaces such as mirrors, pictures, and windows.
  • Clean behind and underneath furnishings.
  • Move furniture to clean behind/underneath, according to center procedures.
  • Turn bed mattresses after cleaning.
  • Clean dining area after breakfast and lunch; wipe tables, sweep, mop, etc.
  • Change soiled privacy curtains and draperies for the outside windows as needed.
  • Remove and rehang curtains and draperies for the outside windows, using a ladder.
  • Sweep outside porches, walkways, etc., pick up any trash not properly disposed.
  • Follow cleaning schedules as set by supervisor.
  • Follow infection control standards while performing cleaning.
  • Use isolation techniques (gowns, gloves, special cleaning, etc.) as needed.
  • Recognize patient rights while cleaning patient rooms. Treat patients and their belongings with dignity and respect.
  • Safeguard chemicals used, keeping chemicals either locked or in sight
  • Follow precautions as stated on MSDS for chemicals used.
  • Assist in the proper care and use of housekeeping equipment, supplies, and storage areas.
  • Clean and properly store equipment used at the end of each shift, following set procedures.
  • Inspect equipment prior to use to provide for safe operation.
  • Report to Maintenance Department any equipment repairs needed throughout the center.
  • Maintain adequate supplies (soap, lotion, paper towels, toilet tissue, etc.) in bathrooms throughout center
  • Prevent/remove wax/dirt build-up in corners, around baseboards, or in doorways.
  • Promotes the image and reputation of the System by exhibiting servant leadership and providing direct and open lines of communication.
  • Contributes to the work of committees, workgroups, project management, and other collaborative efforts of the System.
  • Performs other duties as necessary to ensure the success of the System.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Understands basic cleaning principles and safety related to the handling of chemicals.
  • Communicates well with other associates, patients, family members, and visitors providing warm and friendly greeting and an approachable attitude. Responds to expressed concerns while displaying a helpful, caring demeanor, answers questions when appropriate in a professional manner.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

A high school diploma or its equivalent preferred.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

None.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or associates of the organization.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral or diagram format. The ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

COMPUTER APPLICATION SKILLS

This job requires proficiency with the following computer applications:

skills.title: Special Assistant to the Commissioner
skills.description:
The New York City Department of Youth and Community Development (DYCD) invests in a network of community-based organizations and programs to alleviate the effects of poverty and to provide opportunities for New Yorkers and communities to flourish.

DYCD is recruiting for a Special Assistant to the Commissioner to support the day-to-day operations of the Commissioner’s Office and help ensure effective coordination of priorities, information, and activities across the agency.

This role provides administrative and operational support while also contributing to the organization and flow of work within the Commissioner’s Office.

The Special Assistant will work closely with the Commissioner and the Chief of Staff to support scheduling, information management, and preparation for meetings and engagements. The role serves as a key coordination point between the Commissioner’s Office, internal teams, and external stakeholders, helping to ensure that communication is timely, organized, and responsive.

This position requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable supporting senior leadership while maintaining awareness of agency priorities. The role may also support projects aimed at improving efficiency and coordination within the Commissioner’s Office, including the use of technology and emerging tools such as artificial intelligence.

The role will also provide exposure to the Commissioner’s external engagements, including supporting event coordination and working with internal teams to ensure the Commissioner’s messaging and presence are aligned across communications and social media platforms.

The selected candidate will:

- Support the day-to-day management of the Commissioner’s calendar, including scheduling meetings, coordinating logistics, and ensuring alignment with priorities.

- Prepare, review, and organize materials for meetings, briefings, and external engagements, including agendas and background documents.

- Track follow up items and help ensure timely responses to requests and inquiries.

- Support projects focused on improving workflows and coordination, including the use of technology and tools such as artificial intelligence.

- Serve as a key point of contact between the Commissioner’s Office and internal teams, as well as external stakeholders, including nonprofit providers, community partners, and other City agencies.

- Support the flow and organization of information to and from the Commissioner’s Office to ensure clarity and accessibility.

- Provide coordination support during meetings, site visits, and external events, including accompanying the Commissioner as needed.

- Serve as a coordination point during engagements involving multiple stakeholders, helping to manage requests, organize information, and support the Commissioner in real time.

- Support the preparation of materials in coordination with internal teams, including the Strategic Communications team, to help align messaging and support the Commissioner’s presence across platforms.

- Assist with organizing documents, files, and systems to improve efficiency and accessibility of information.

- Exercise discretion and sound judgment in handling sensitive or confidential information.

- Work closely with the Commissioner’s scheduler to coordinate calendar needs, ensure continuity, and support effective management of scheduling priorities.

- Coordinate with scheduling teams and executive staff across City Hall and partner agencies to arrange meetings and events.

EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT TO THE COM - 95700

1. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and three years of satisfactory full-time progressively responsible clerical/administrative experience, one year of which must have been in an high level administrative capacity or supervising staff performing clerical/administrative work of more than moderate difficulty; or
2. An associate degree or 60 semester credits from an accredited college and four years of satisfactory full-time progressively responsible clerical/administrative experience including one year of the high level administrative capacity experience described in "1" above; or

3. A four-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent approved by a State's department of education or a recognized accrediting organization and five years of satisfactory full-time progressively responsible clerical/administrative experience including one year of the administrative experience as described in "1" above.

The City of New York is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy.

skills.title: Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions - LATAM
skills.description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.

The Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions manages employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources when needed.

As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Specialist is also expected to contribute to process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

What you bring

  • Experience as a HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.
  • Proven experience with a strong background in managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR support and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.
  • Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues, undertake research, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.
  • Basic understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to confidently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.
  • Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.
  • Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying and implementing opportunities for automation and championing best practices.
  • Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.
  • Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment with multiple priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

Offboarding

  • Manage and resolve end-to-end employee exits (offboardings) across multiple international jurisdictions, including AMER,EMEA and APAC regions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and their employees.
  • Provide sound guidance and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.
  • Lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.
  • Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, balancing multiple stakeholders with competing interests.
  • Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.
  • Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.
  • Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, amongst other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.
  • Be the subject-matter expert and respond to internal and external queries on all offboarding matters in conjunction with Employee Relations internal stakeholders.
  • Navigate clients through Remote's Employee Relations resources and guides, helping them understand applicable policies and processes.
  • Conduct preliminary assessment of workplace concerns, identifying key facts and applicable local regulations.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure appropriate handling of employee relations matters.
  • Support clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches and documentation requirements.
  • Monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Actively identify opportunities for and contribute to process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Team: Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Location: For this position we welcome everyone to apply, but we will prioritise applications from the following locations as we encourage our teams to diversify;
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Application process

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Test
  3. Interview with future manager
  4. Interview with team members (no managers present)
  5. Bar Raiser Interview
  6. Offer
  7. Prior employment verification check

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is
$37,250—$41,900 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • learning budget
  • home office budget & IT equipment
  • budget for local in-person social events or co-working spaces

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see here.

Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

skills.title: Director Operational Excellence
skills.description:
