skills.description:
University Overview

The University of Pennsylvania, the largest private employer in Philadelphia, is a world-renowned leader in education, research, and innovation. This historic, Ivy League school consistently ranks among the top 10 universities in the annual U.S. News & World Report survey. Penn has 12 highly-regarded schools that provide opportunities for undergraduate, graduate and continuing education, all influenced by Penn’s distinctive interdisciplinary approach to scholarship and learning. As an employer Penn has been ranked nationally on many occasions with the most recent award from Forbes who named Penn one of America’s Best Large Employers in 2023.

Penn offers a unique working environment within the city of Philadelphia. The University is situated on a beautiful urban campus, with easy access to a range of educational, cultural, and recreational activities. With its historical significance and landmarks, lively cultural offerings, and wide variety of atmospheres, Philadelphia is the perfect place to call home for work and play.

The University offers a competitive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits, a wealth of health and wellness programs and resources, and much more.

Posted Job Title

Clinical Research Coordinator

Job Profile Title

Clinical Research Coordinator A

Job Description Summary

As part of the Department of Psychiatry, Neurodevelopment and Psychosis Division, the Penn Psychosis Evaluation and Recovery Center (PERC) offers consultations on diagnosis, treatment, support and skill development for adolescents and young adults (ages 16-35 years) who exhibit warning signs of emerging psychosis or early psychosis, and their families. The Clinical Coordinator will be responsible for providing support for PERC staff, patients and family members.

Position contingent upon funding.

Job Description

The Psychosis Evaluation and Recovery Center (PERC) in the Neurodevelopment and Psychosis Section of the Department of Psychiatry at the University of Pennsylvania is seeking a Clinical Coordinator to

- Provide supported employment and education services (SEES) at the PERC clinic offices, in the community, or virtually

- Conduct screenings of referred individuals to help determine program eligibility, appointment scheduling and billing

- Provide administrative support for PERC operations, including referral tracking, eligibility screening coordination, appointment scheduling, billing-related coordination, documentation, database entry, and other clinic/program support tasks as needed

- Develop relationships with potential employers, educational programs, and job training organizations to support participants' employment, education, and training goals

The Clinical Coordinator will provide SEES services under the supervision of the SEES Supervisor and work closely with the Team Lead and to provide individualized care to young people with early psychosis as part of a multidisciplinary care team. SEES are an essential component of coordinated specialty care for early psychosis and include supporting the young person in exploring interests and goals, navigating educational and employment pathways and programs, pursuing employment opportunities including assistance with job searches, applications, resumes, and interviews, school or training program navigation, and providing support around academic or workplace accommodations.

Qualifications

Bachelor degree in a health related field and 1 to 2 years of experience or equivalent combination of education and experience is required. The person will be trained in SEES through the Individual Placement and Support Employment Center. The applicant should be comfortable working with young persons, their families, and the public, including school professionals and employers involved with PERC participants. The applicant should demonstrate excellent organizational and interpersonal skills. Excellent communication and writing skills are required. Must be able to adhere to all confidentiality requirements at all times. Must be able to work in a team environment and may be expected to work in the field. Experience with computerized databases is essential. Applicant should be able to multi-task and shift from one project to another depending upon priority.

Job Location - City, State

Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

Department / School

Perelman School of Medicine

Pay Range

$47,313.00 - $50,000.00 Annual Rate

Salary offers are made based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and education as they directly relate to the requirements of the position, and in alignment with salary ranges based on external market data for the job’s level. Internal organization and peer data at Penn are also considered.

Equal Opportunity Statement

The University of Pennsylvania is an equal opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, religion, creed, national origin (including shared ancestry or ethnic characteristics), citizenship status, age, disability, veteran status or any class protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

Special Requirements
Background checks may be required after a conditional job offer is made. Consideration of the background check will be tailored to the requirements of the job.

University Benefits

  • Health, Life, and Flexible Spending Accounts: Penn offers comprehensive medical, prescription, behavioral health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits to protect you and your family’s health and welfare. You can also use flexible spending accounts to pay for eligible health care and dependent care expenses with pre-tax dollars.

  • Tuition: Take advantage of Penn's exceptional tuition benefits. You, your spouse, and your dependent children can get tuition assistance here at Penn. Your dependent children are also eligible for tuition assistance at other institutions.

  • Retirement: Penn offers generous retirement plans to help you save for your future. Penn’s Basic, Matching, and Supplemental retirement plans allow you to save for retirement on a pre-tax or Roth basis. Choose from a wide variety of investment options through TIAA and Vanguard.

  • Time Away from Work: Penn provides you with a substantial amount of time away from work during the course of the year. This allows you to relax, take vacations, attend to personal affairs, recover from illness or injury, spend time with family—whatever your personal needs may be.

  • Long-Term Care Insurance: In partnership with Genworth Financial, Penn offers faculty and staff (and your eligible family members) long-term care insurance to help you cover some of the costs of long-term care services received at home, in the community or in a nursing facility. If you apply when you’re newly hired, you won’t have to provide proof of good health or be subject to underwriting requirements. Eligible family members must always provide proof of good health and are subject to underwriting.

  • Wellness and Work-life Resources: Penn is committed to supporting our faculty and staff as they balance the competing demands of work and personal life. That’s why we offer a wide variety of programs and resources to help you care for your health, your family, and your work-life balance.

  • Professional and Personal Development: Penn provides an array of resources to help you advance yourself personally and professionally.

  • University Resources: As a member of the Penn community, you have access to a wide range of University resources as well as cultural and recreational activities. Take advantage of the University’s libraries and athletic facilities, or visit our arboretum and art galleries. There’s always something going on at Penn, whether it’s a new exhibit at the Penn Museum, the latest music or theater presentation at the Annenberg Center, or the Penn Relays at Franklin Field to name just a few examples. As a member of the Penn community, you’re right in the middle of the excitement—and you and your family can enjoy many of these activities for free.

  • Discounts and Special Services: From arts and entertainment to transportation and mortgages, you'll find great deals for University faculty and staff. Not only do Penn arts and cultural centers and museums offer free and discounted admission and memberships to faculty and staff. You can also enjoy substantial savings on other goods and services such as new cars from Ford and General Motors, cellular phone service plans, movie tickets, and admission to theme parks.

  • Flexible Work Hours: Flexible work options offer creative approaches for completing work while promoting balance between work and personal commitments. These approaches involve use of non-traditional work hours, locations, and/or job structures.

  • Penn Home Ownership Services: Penn offers a forgivable loan for eligible employees interested in buying a home or currently residing in West Philadelphia, which can be used for closing costs or home improvements.

  • Adoption Assistance: Penn will reimburse eligible employees on qualified expenses in connection with the legal adoption of an eligible child, such as travel or court fees, for up to two adoptions in your household.

​

To learn more, please visit: https://www.hr.upenn.edu/PennHR/benefits-pay

skills.title: AI Engineer (Production LLM, RAG, Agents)
skills.description:
Не просто код, а твій вплив на мільйони українців
Nova Digital — це технологічне серце екосистеми NOVA, де твій код стає частиною щоденного життя цілої країни.
Про масштаб наших сервісів:

  • 50+ млн запитів щодня проходять через наші системи
  • 10+ млн активних користувачів покладаються на наші рішення

Ми будуємо не просто продукт — ми створюємо технологічну інфраструктуру, яка об’єднує людей, бізнеси та можливості вже майже по цілому світу.
Шукаємо AI Engineer для розробки та впровадження AI-рішень у високонавантажену екосистему (R&D). Робота з Computer Vision, NLP, ASR та Agentic AI для автоматизації процесів логістики та клієнтського сервісу.
Про проект: Комунікаційна платформа — це сучасна комплексна екосистема для розробки та підтримки розумних чат-ботів (як для клієнтів, так і для внутрішнього використання командою). Платформа інтегрується з великими базами знань та виконує широкий спектр завдань: класифікація текстів, транскрибація аудіо, розпізнавання зображень у чатах та глибокий семантичний аналіз (semantic analysis).

Що робитимеш як AI Engineer :
Розробка та тренування: повний цикл створення ML моделей (CV, NLP, ASR) - від підготовки даних до валідації результатів.
AI Agents: Побудова логіки роботи агентів для автоматизації бізнес-процесів.
Model Serving: Підготовка моделей до продуктивного запуску (експорт у ONNX/TensorRT, контейнеризація, налаштування середовища виконання).
Інтеграційні контракти: Формування чітких специфікацій (вхідні/вихідні дані, формати) для передачі моделі Backend-команді на впровадження.
Оптимізація: Зменшення розміру моделей та прискорення інференсу (quantization, pruning) без втрати якості.
Моніторинг якості: Відстеження метрик роботи моделі в реальних умовах (drift detection) та її донавчання при зміні даних.

Твій ідеальний профіль:
Must-have:
Комерційний досвід роботи з Python в області машинного навчання (ML/DL) від 2-х років.
Повний цикл роботи з даними та моделями: Практичний досвід збору, очищення, підготовки та аугментації датасетів, а також безпосереднього тренування та валідації класичних ML-моделей.
Досвід роботи з ML-фреймворками: Pytorch, Tensorflow, Scikit-learn, ONNX, TensorRT.
Глибоке розуміння LLM та Transformer-моделей: практичний досвід побудови систем з використанням RAG.
AI Agents: Досвід створення та розгортання агентів (Langchain, CrewAI, AutoGen, open-agents).
Cloud AI: Досвід інтеграції з хмарними платформами (Google AI, OpenAI, Claude тощо).
Впевнене володіння українською, англійська - на рівні читання технічної документації.

Nice-to-have:
Знання систем побудови агентних графів: LangGraph, Semantic Kernel.
Розуміння архітектури багатоагентних систем: планування, розділення ролей.
Досвід генерації складних документів та дій із використанням LLM як backend-ядра.
Практика інтеграції LLM у корпоративні продукти.

Специфіка ролі:

Виконання технічних задач: Написання робочого коду, побудова пайплайнів, тренування та інтеграція моделей.
Технологічний стек: Основна мова - Python. Використовуємо інструменти та бібліотеки, необхідні для вирішення конкретної технічної задачі.
Фокус на результаті: Перетворення бізнес-вимог на робочий функціонал (PoC -> MVP -> Production). Головний критерій - працездатність сервісу та відповідність метрикам.

Чому експерти різних напрямів працюють з нами:
Технологічно:
Високонавантажені системи з реальними викликами масштабування
Сучасний стек та свобода технологічних рішень
Можливість впливати на архітектуру продуктів, якими користуються мільйони
Професійно:
Менторство від сеньйорів з досвідом enterprise-рішень
Разом будуємо інновації, що працюють для мільйонів
Ідейно:
Продукт, що змінює країну — не просто ще один стартап
Тут команди стають драйверами технологічних змін
Benefits:
Компенсація додаткових витрат, пов'язаних з робочими завданнями, здійснюються до внутрішніх політик компаній.
Добровільне медичне страхування та страхування життя.
Корпоративні знижки від партнерів NOVA.
Підтримка ментального здоров'я. Можливість безоплатних консультацій з корпоративним психологом.
Соціальна відповідальність та волонтерський рух “Свої для своїх”.
Клуби за інтересами: біговий, шаховий та інші ініціативи для натхнення.
Соціальні відпустки та компенсації відповідно до КЗпП України.
Наступний крок за тобою.
Ми чекаємо на знайомство — залишилось лише отримати твоє резюме.
Очікуваний термін відповіді — до 10 робочих днів.

The Opportunity

The Department of Health Sciences in the College of Health Professions and Sciences (CHPS) at the University of Central Florida (UCF) invites applications for a 12-month, non-tenure earning, lecturer position. The position is open to doctoral level Registered Dietitian Nutritionists who hold valid credentials through the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR). The preferred start date is as early as January 2027, but no later than August 2027.

The Department of Health Sciences is home to 19 full-time faculty and approximately 3000 undergraduate students in the major and about 500 students in the minor. We offer an undergraduate degree in Health Sciences with two tracks – Pre-Clinical and Health Promotion and a Master of Science degree in Health Promotion and Behavioral Science. We are seeking a dynamic and collaborative faculty member to support the development, implementation and ongoing operation of a newly approved Master of Science in Nutrition Science and Dietetics, with the goal of achieving ACEND candidacy as a Nutrition and Dietetics Coordinated Program (CP). This position plays a pivotal role as a coordinator working in tandem with the program director in shaping an innovative, competency-based graduate program designed to prepare future Registered Dietitian Nutritionists through integrated coursework and supervised experiential learning.

skills.title: Commissioning and Installation Engineer
skills.description:
About CRA Energy

CRA Energy is a Noida-based manufacturer of custom-engineered process and combustion equipment, including flare systems, thermal oxidizers, biogas compression and upgrading systems, gas processing skids, burners, H₂S scrubbers, and other environmental process packages. Every project is engineered-to-order and executed from design through commissioning for customers across India and international markets.

Purpose of the Role

The Commissioning & Installation Engineer / Technician is responsible for the successful installation, mechanical completion, commissioning, and handover of H₂S Scrubber Systems and associated process equipment at customer sites. The role ensures that every installation is executed safely, on schedule, and in accordance with engineering specifications while delivering the guaranteed H₂S removal performance.

This position serves as the technical lead during site execution, coordinating with project engineers, contractors, vendors, and customers to ensure seamless commissioning and successful project completion.

Key Responsibilities

1. Installation & Site Supervision

  • Supervise the installation of H₂S scrubber columns, ducting, recirculation pumps, piping, chemical dosing systems, and associated process equipment.
  • Ensure installation complies with approved engineering drawings, P&IDs, GA drawings, and OEM specifications.
  • Coordinate with rigging teams, crane operators, contractors, and site personnel for safe lifting, positioning, and anchoring of heavy equipment.
  • Verify equipment alignment, leveling, and mechanical integrity before commissioning.
  • Coordinate with civil, electrical, and instrumentation teams to ensure timely project execution.
  • Monitor installation quality and resolve site execution issues in coordination with the engineering team.

2. Testing & Commissioning

  • Perform pre-commissioning inspections and mechanical completion activities.
  • Conduct hydrostatic, leak, and pressure testing of piping and process equipment.
  • Verify alignment and operational readiness of pumps, blowers, fans, and rotating equipment.
  • Calibrate and commission field instruments including:
    • H₂S Gas Analysers
    • pH Meters
    • ORP Meters
    • Conductivity Meters
    • Flow Meters
    • Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)
  • Supervise loading of packing media and charging of scrubbing chemicals.
  • Perform static and dynamic loop checks.
  • Execute dry commissioning and wet commissioning trials.
  • Validate airflow, pressure drop, and H₂S removal efficiency to meet project guarantees (typically 95–99% removal efficiency).
  • Troubleshoot commissioning issues and optimize system performance before customer handover.

3. Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)

  • Enforce strict H₂S safety procedures and site safety regulations throughout installation and commissioning.
  • Ensure mandatory use of PPE, portable gas detectors, and emergency response equipment.
  • Conduct Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Toolbox Talks, and risk assessments before commencement of work.
  • Ensure safe handling, storage, and disposal of chemicals in accordance with statutory and environmental regulations.
  • Promote a zero-incident safety culture at all project sites.

4. Documentation & Handover

  • Prepare Mechanical Completion Certificates, Pre-Commissioning Checklists, Commissioning Reports, Punch Lists, and Site Progress Reports.
  • Maintain complete commissioning documentation and testing records.
  • Conduct operator training covering system operation, routine maintenance, chemical dosing, troubleshooting, and safety procedures.
  • Support final customer acceptance testing and project handover.
  • Provide post-commissioning technical support where required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Zero Lost Time Injuries (LTI) during installation and commissioning.
  • Completion of installation and commissioning within the planned project schedule.
  • Achievement of guaranteed H₂S removal efficiency (≥95%) under design operating conditions.
  • Successful mechanical completion with minimum punch-list items.
  • Timely submission of commissioning documentation and handover reports.
  • High customer satisfaction during commissioning and project close-out.


Requirements

Must Have

  • 3–8 years of experience in installation, commissioning, startup, or maintenance of industrial process equipment.
  • Experience with H₂S Scrubbers, Biogas Upgrading Systems, Chemical Scrubbers, Biological Scrubbers, Gas Treatment Systems, Air Pollution Control Equipment, or similar process plants.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical installation, piping systems, pumps, blowers, and rotating equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, GA drawings, Isometric Drawings, and engineering documents.
  • Hands-on experience with field instrumentation calibration and commissioning.
  • Knowledge of corrosion-resistant materials including FRP, PP, HDPE, and Stainless Steel.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to travel extensively to project sites across India and overseas.

Good to Have

  • Experience in biogas, wastewater treatment, renewable energy, chemical process plants, or environmental engineering projects.
  • Familiarity with PLC-based control systems and SCADA interfaces.
  • Experience in chemical dosing systems and water treatment processes.
  • Exposure to FAT, SAT, and performance guarantee testing.
  • Knowledge of international safety standards and commissioning practices.
  • Basic understanding of electrical and instrumentation systems during commissioning.

This role offers an opportunity to work on advanced gas treatment and biogas upgrading projects, contributing directly to the successful delivery of engineered environmental solutions for clients in India and across global markets.






Benefits

  • Every project is custom-engineered — technically interesting work with real problem-solving, not catalogue order-taking.
  • Growing international footprint across biogas, oil & gas, and defence sectors.
  • Lean, ownership-driven culture — high autonomy, direct access to leadership, and visible impact.

Posted Job Title

Research Specialist B

skills.title: Especialista em Desenvolvimento Tecnológico Jr (Química Molecular - 434545)
skills.company: Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM)
skills.description:
Para atuar no grupo de Química Molecular do Laboratório Nacional de Biorrenováveis (LNBR)


O grupo de Química Molecular atua de forma transversal no suporte a projetos de pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação, oferecendo soluções analíticas baseadas em cromatografia, espectrometria de massas e outras técnicas instrumentais para caracterização química de biomassa, bioprodutos, bioprocessos e amostras ambientais. A QM desenvolve e aplica métodos analíticos, opera infraestrutura de alta complexidade, presta suporte técnico-científico aos pesquisadores e coordena a plataforma de metabolômica da Instalação Aberta de Multi-Ômicas do CNPEM.


  • Planejar, executar e interpretar experimentos de metabolômica utilizando cromatografia líquida de ultra eficiência (UPLC), incluindo cromatografia bidimensional (2D-LC), acoplada à espectrometria de massas de alta resolução (HRMS) com analisador quadrupolo-tempo de voo (Q-ToF) e mobilidade iônica (IMS);
  • Atuar como referência técnica em metabolômica, apoiando pesquisadores do LNBR no planejamento experimental, desenvolvimento e otimização de metodologias analíticas conduzindo todas as etapas do fluxo analítico, desde o preparo de amostras até a aquisição, processamento e interpretação dos dados;
  • Desenvolver, implementar e aprimorar pipelines computacionais para processamento, interpretação e análise estatística de dados metabolômicos, utilizando PLS Toolbox no MATLAB, plataformas open source e ferramentas computacionais especializadas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades da plataforma de metabolômica da Instalação Aberta de Multi-Ômicas, incluindo a seleção e acompanhamento de propostas de usuários, o planejamento da agenda de utilização do equipamento de UPLC-HRMS, o recebimento de usuários e amostras, e a interação técnica e científica durante todas as etapas dos projetos;
  • Assegurar o funcionamento e a conservação do sistema de UPLC-HRMS, acompanhando manutenções preventivas e corretivas, gerenciando o contrato de manutenção e suas renovações, e atuando como ponto focal junto aos fabricantes.


  • Graduação completa em Química, Engenharia Química, Bioquímica, Farmácia, Biotecnologia, Biologia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação em Química, Bioquímica, Biotecnologia, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em metabolômica untargeted por cromatografia líquida acoplada à espectrometria de massas de alta resolução (LC-HRMS), incluindo o desenvolvimento e otimização de metodologias;
  • Experiência na implementação e utilização de pipelines computacionais para processamento de dados metabolômicos;
  • Experiência em planejamento experimental, preparo de amostras, aquisição, processamento, interpretação e análise de dados metabolômicos, incluindo conhecimentos em quimiometria e análise estatística multivariada;
  • Inglês avançado.


Desejável


  • Experiência com instrumentação e softwares da Waters (MassLynx e Progenesis QI);
  • Experiência com espectrometria de massas com mobilidade iônica (IMS/HDMS);
  • Experiência na utilização de MATLAB (incluindo PLS Toolbox) e outras ferramentas computacionais aplicadas ao processamento, análise e interpretação de dados metabolômicos.

  • Building engineering prototypes which is kind of R&D (POC, Reference architecture), pre- implementation prototypes which are building blocks which perform in pre-production with minor tweaks.

Identity & Access Architecture

  • Architect a unified, vendor-agnostic identity fabric across Ford's global enterprise, resolving the complexity of a multi-IdP environment while eliminating vendor lock-in.
  • Define modern application authorization patterns — including OAuth On-Behalf-Of (OBO) flows and delegated access models — that scale securely across applications, APIs, and AI agents.
  • Establish governance standards spanning workforce, customer, and machine/non-human identities.

AI & Agent Security Governance

  • Define and enforce enterprise-wide governance frameworks for MCP, APIs, Agents, and Skills.
  • Partner with the Platform team (EPEO) to evaluate and govern the enterprise, AI Gateway.
  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of the agent-building ecosystem — low-code/no-code and pro-code options using Microsoft and Gemini Enterprise, plus hands-on expertise in the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) — to guide secure, scalable agent adoption.
  • Collaborate with GDAI and data/AI teams to keep governance aligned with the pace of enterprise AI innovation.

Engineering Excellence – Patterns & Reference Architecture

  • Design and publish reusable patterns and reference architectures for AI solutions, giving teams across Ford consistent, secure building blocks rather than ad-hoc implementations.
  • Build starter apps/templates for the Google ADK, providing pro-code agent developers a secure, governed foundation to build from.
  • Define reference implementations mapping OAuth OBO flows with Microsoft Agent ID, ensuring agents securely act on behalf of users with proper identity context and audit trails.
  • Continuously evolve these patterns as Microsoft, Google, and other providers update their agent identity and authorization models.
  • Ensure starter kits and patterns are pre-approved, governance-compliant building blocks reducing time-to-production for new AI use cases.

Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture

  • Lead strategy for multi-cloud interoperability, ensuring consistent, portable security architecture across cloud providers.
  • Maintain a strong command of GCP architecture — scalability, resiliency, and cost/FinOps — to guide sound, cost-conscious infrastructure decisions. Partnering with FinOps EPEO team for the cost of architecture.
  • Partner with cybersecurity and EPEO infrastructure teams to ensure governance controls are technically enforceable across tooling and platforms.
  • Architect security solutions that directly protect and enable Ford's core business platforms — eCommerce, Ford Credit (global banking and financial services), and global retail/commercial fleet customer platforms.
  • Balance security rigor with speed-to-market for digital initiatives.

Applied AI & Insights

  • Apply predictive AI models to real enterprise use cases, delivering actionable insights that inform security, architecture, and business strategy.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with cybersecurity, platform (EPEO), infrastructure, and data/AI (GDAI) teams to align governance and reference architectures with evolving platform capabilities and enterprise roadmaps.
  • Serve as a key architectural liaison between security, engineering, and business stakeholders.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a cross-functional team of 20+ polyglot architects (Java, UI, AI, Python, GCP).
  • Build a culture of Engineering Excellence — driving technical rigor, continuous learning, and cross-skilling.
  • Set team goals and objectives , priorities, and development paths aligned with enterprise architecture measure success by defining OKRs and KPIs.

Strategic Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a Director-level technical authority on identity, API, and AI security governance, representing Enterprise Architecture in senior technical and business forums.
  • Proactively shape Ford's approach to secure, scalable AI adoption — anticipating emerging risks and technologies ahead of business impact.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise architecture, cybersecurity architecture, or platform engineering, including significant time in identity & access management (IAM) and API security architecture.
  • Proven, hands-on experience architecting multi-IdP identity environments, with deep knowledge of protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML — including practical implementation of OBO (On-Behalf-Of) flows and delegated authorization patterns.
  • Demonstrated experience with API gateway architecture, threat protection, and API lifecycle governance at enterprise scale.
  • Practical, current knowledge of AI agent frameworks and ecosystems — Microsoft Copilot Studio/Agent frameworks, Gemini Enterprise, and the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) — including building or evaluating low-code/no-code vs. pro-code agent solutions.
  • Working understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and emerging standards for AI agent governance and interoperability.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) architecture, including scalability, resiliency patterns, and cost/FinOps optimization.
  • Experience applying predictive AI/ML models to business use cases, with the ability to translate technical outcomes into business insight.
  • Proven track record leading and developing large, technically diverse teams (20+), ideally across Java, Python, UI, AI, and cloud disciplines.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills — able to represent technical strategy to senior business and technology leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Multi-cloud architecture experience (GCP plus AWS/Azure), particularly around interoperability and portability of security controls.

  • Champion a shift-left approach to API security and compliance by embedding automated checks directly into the build phase, catching issues early in the development lifecycle; familiarity with security tooling such as FOSSA, Cycode, 42Crunch, and PRISMA is a strong plus.

  • Prior experience in the automotive, manufacturing, or large-scale digital/eCommerce enterprise environment.

  • Relevant certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect or any security/architecture certifications are a plus.

  • Experience contributing to or leading greenfield architecture practices — building governance frameworks, standards, and teams from the ground up rather than inheriting mature processes.

  • Exposure to regulated industries (financial services, banking/fintech) given the role's proximity to Ford Credit's global banking and financial platforms.

  • Familiarity with DevSecOps pipelines and CI/CD integration, enabling security and compliance controls to be enforced as code rather than manual gates.

  • Understanding AI/ML model risk and governance frameworks, complementing the role's focus on predictive AI and agent governance.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field required.

skills.title: Physiotherapy Assistant
skills.description:
Job Advert

Physiotherapy Assistant

Oaklands Hospital, Salford

Full Time, 37.5 Hours

We have an exciting opportunity to recruit a Physiotherapy Assistant to join our friendly and dynamic team at Oaklands Hospital based in Salford.

The role

This is a varied post and involves a mixture of clinical duties on the ward alongside the inpatient team and in the outpatient department. Clinical duties include working alongside physiotherapists on the ward seeing orthopaedic patients and in the outpatient team assisting with post-operative rehabilitation classes and physiotherapy pre assessment clinics. There will also be the necessity to support the team with administrative duties.

This position would be an ideal opportunity if you are looking to broaden your knowledge and skills, or intend to train as a Physiotherapist in the future.

The physiotherapy department delivers a structured in-service training programme, underpinned by regular clinical supervision, mentoring, and peer group support. The job involves the safe moving and handling of patients and equipment so the successful applicant must have good physical health to meet this need.

We are looking to employ a motivated individual who enjoys working with people. Hours for this role will be full time 37.5, spread over 5 days with the expectation of some weekend work on the ward rota, however part time hours would be considered for the right candidate.

What you'll bring with you

  • Experience of working as a therapy assistant or in a hospital/caring rehabilitation environment is desirable

  • Sound written and verbal communication skills

  • Basic computer skills

  • Excellent customer service skills

At Ramsay Health Care UK, our people are at the heart of our success. Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, work-life balance and career development, because we’re people caring for people:

Health, Wellbeing & Financial Security

  • Access to our benefits platform, offering a wide range of discounts

Ramsay Health Care UK is a well-established global hospital group with over 50 years’ experience. We are a global provider operating in 11 countries with 77,000 staff who treat 8 million patients each year. We are well known for our strong, long-standing relationship with the NHS.


We love people with a positive, “can do” attitude who want to make a difference in their work. "Our employees are Ramsay." The skills and commitment of our employees forms the basis for our success.


We are able to support training and development to our employees, to deliver a high standard of clinical care whilst ensuring patient safety, dignity and confidentiality. We are a progressive and caring facility and support the Ramsay vision “People caring for People”. We know our people are our greatest asset, our business is growing and we would like you to join us.


We are proud of our ‘Speak Up for Safety’ programme and ensure that the patient is at the heart of everything we do. Join us and have more ‘Time to Care’.

We value your application and welcome any questions you may have prior to applying. Please be advised that we reserve the right to close our advertisements prior to the announced closing date to ensure a quality recruitment process

skills.title: Senior Network Cloud Engineer
skills.description:
We're fast learners, hard workers, natural collaborators... and we Make Modern Happen!

Our ambition is to unlock the potential of our digital world so that organisations everywhere can innovate and thrive securely.

We aim to achieve this goal by bringing together the world’s most talented people and the most powerful technologies, combining them to address our customers' challenges and to build something stronger together.

If you share our vision, join us!

Right now, we are looking for a Senior Network Cloud Engineer to integrate our internal team, based in Lisbon or Porto.


Your responsibilities include:

  • Design and evolution of secure, scalable, and resilient network architectures across Azure and multi-cloud environments;
  • Architect and manage advanced Azure networking services, including VNets, NSGs, Application Gateways, Load Balancers, VPN Gateways, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, and Private Endpoints;
  • Design secure hybrid connectivity across on-premises, Azure, and GCP environments, ensuring robust routing, performance, and security;
  • Take ownership of network optimisation, diagnostics, and troubleshooting, using tools such as Azure Network Watcher, traffic analytics, Wireshark, and tcpdump;
  • Strengthen network security through micro-segmentation, Zero Trust principles, and secure access controls;
  • Support SecOps activities across Azure, including alert management, security recommendations, and response to EOL-related impact in complex tenant environments;
  • Develop automation and Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform, ARM templates, Bicep, PowerShell, Python, or Bash;
  • Design and support container networking for AKS and other Kubernetes platforms, including CNI, ingress, service mesh, and network policy considerations;
  • Produce clear technical documentation, topology diagrams, and operational standards to support governance and repeatability;
  • Collaborate closely with security, platform, and application teams to ensure alignment between network design, security posture, and business objectives.


You must have:

  • Deep expertise in Azure networking and strong understanding of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, DNS, and network security;
  • Proven experience operating in hybrid and multi-cloud environments;
  • Strong background in network automation and Infrastructure as Code;
  • Hands-on experience with SecOps, cloud security controls, and incident response;
  • Solid Kubernetes networking knowledge, ideally in AKS;
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to operate effectively in complex, fast-moving environments;
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.


We value:

Bank MRI CT Radiographer
skills.description:
Job Advert

Bank MRI CT Radiographer

Buckshaw Hospital, Chorley

The role

At Ramsay Health Care UK, we know our people are our most important asset. Join us as an MRI Radiographer where you’ll be valued for your skills and expertise, as well as having the chance to build on them through our Ramsay Academy. We will give you access to the latest state-of-the-art equipment and technology too.

You will be part of a close-knit, innovative MRI team delivering an exceptional diagnostic imaging service. At the heart of patient care, you’ll build relationships with all the hospital’s key departments, and our consultants across many specialisms. Whilst providing exceptional clinical care, you’ll also track, process and manage images in RIS and PACS, perform audits and assist in booking in patients. But at its heart, this role is about playing a key role in the diagnosis, treatment, and care of your patients.

Where you’ll be based

Buckshaw Hospital is the third day case hospital to have been built and opened by Ramsay in the last two years. The new development is located at Matrix Park, Buckshaw Village, Chorley. It is an extension of services offered by Euxton and Fulwood Hall Hospitals. The Ramsay Team at Euxton and Fulwood are incredibly excited about the new hospital, not only does it provide further capacity to treat patients in and around the local area, but it develops the service model we already offer in the North West, delivering the best care and patient experience.

What you’ll bring with you

  • Diploma or degree in diagnostic Radiography

  • HCPC registration and evidence of post registration development

  • SOR IV cannulation certificate desirable

  • Sound written and verbal communication skills

  • Proven ability to work effectively in a team environment and independently as required

  • Passion to deliver high quality diagnostic services

  • Ability to participate in on call rota and work evening/weekends as required

What we give back to you

  • Competitive hourly rates plus enhancements

  • Free DBS

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Excellent training and development opportunities

  • Free parking and subsidised staff restaurant (subject to site facilities)

  • Free uniform

  • Access to Blue Light Card

​

What is a Bank contract

A Bank contract at Ramsay Health Care UK is a flexible employment agreement where you are not committed to a set number of hours per week. Instead, you work on an ad-hoc basis, filling in shifts that we have available in our hospitals. A Bank contract is ideal for individuals seeking flexibility, as it allows you to choose shifts that fit your availability, leaving you with a greater work-life balance. Bank contracts are also a fantastic way to secure additional income alongside other contracted work. Our Bank staff play a crucial role in maintaining service levels during peak times or staff shortages, ensuring that patient care remains uninterrupted."

About us

Ramsay Health Care UK is a well-established global hospital group with over 50 years’ experience. We are a global provider operating in 11 countries with 77,000 staff who treat 8 million patients each year. It is well respected within the healthcare industry and is one of the leading providers of independent hospital services in England. We are well known for our strong, long-standing relationship with the NHS.

We love people with a positive, “can do” attitude who want to make a difference in their work. "Our employees are Ramsay." The skills and commitment of our employees forms the basis for our success.

We know our people are our greatest asset, our business is growing and we would like you to join us. “The Ramsay Way” culture recognises that people – staff and doctors – are Ramsay Health Care’s most important asset and this has been key to our ongoing success.

We are proud of our ‘Speak Up for Safety’ programme and ensure that the patient is at the heart of everything we do. Join us and have more ‘Time to Care’.

We care. It’s more than what we do, it’s who we are. Everything we do is about striving to deliver the best care. And it's a belief that's as true today as it was when we welcomed our first patients in 1964. “The Ramsay Way” culture recognises that our people are our most important asset and this has been key to our ongoing success.

We are committed to equality of opportunity for all. This position is subject to background and DBS checks.

We are proud to support the UK’s Armed Forces and Reservists and have already achieved the Silver Award as part of the MOD’s Armed Forces Covenant Employer Recognition Scheme. The scheme recognises employers who actively support Defence while encouraging other organisations to adopt the same behaviours in their workplace. As a company we are committed to supporting the wider Armed Forces community and this includes our staff as well as our patients.

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of adults, children and young people at risk. We expect all employees to share this commitment and behave in a way that supports it. All successful candidates will be provided with safeguarding training appropriate to their role.

At arbejde som sælger på Circle K er ikke som ethvert sælgerjob. Os der arbejder her er vilde med det, og spørger du en af vores uundværlige sælgere om hvorfor, vil de bl.a. nævne: Selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og ansvar.

  • Har en sælger gemt I sig, motiveres af salg og kan levere en service lidt ud over det sædvanlige

  • Kan bevare overblikket og humøret, når der kommer uforudsete udfordringer ind af døren, og formår at løse dem med sund fornuft. Også selvom der er lang kø

Vi er en dynamisk, handlingsorienteret organisation, hvor vi arbejder sammen som ét team. Vi tager ikke os selv alt for højtideligt og engagerer os ikke i politik eller bureaukrati. Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på.

Det er altafgørende at du har lysten og motivationen til at lære nye ting, udvikle dig og bidrage til vores ”one-team” kultur. Hvis du har ambitionen om at bygge en karriere, får du unikke muligheder i Circle K, så længe du har den motivation der skal til.

Udover helt unikke udviklingsmuligheder, tilbyder vi et job med yderst attraktive fordele og personalegoder. Som en del af vores Circle K familie vil du bl.a. få medarbejderrabat på brændstof, bilvask samt på mad og drikkevarer i vores butikker.

Derudover tilbyder vi:

  • En attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring

  • Fordelagtige lønninger og forskudttidstillæg

  • Og ikke mindst, Danmarks bedste kollegaer

Så hvis du vil have et job, hvor du kan være med til at give vores kunder den bedste oplevelse, udvikle dig og blive en del af et fantastisk team på Circle K Sct. Jørgens Park i Næstved, så er det nu du skal sende din ansøgning afsted.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Store Manager Pernille Grabas Munk på tlf. nr.: 55 72 62 12

Antal timer:

8-10 timer om ugen med mulighed for ekstra timer i perioder.

Vagtfordeling:
Fast vagtplan med hverdage og weekends vagter

Arbejdstiden giver mulighed for, at stillingen kan varetages som enten almindeligt sælgerjob eller studiejob. Det er en forudsætning for at komme i betragtning til stillingen, at du er fyldt 18 år.

Ansøgningsfrist og tiltrædelse:

Løbende

Som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen, indhenter vi referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgivere.

Hos os behøver du, hverken CV eller ansøgning for at søge job. Når du trykker på ”ansøg nu” kommer du til en portal, hvor du skal svare på nogle spørgsmål om forskellige arbejdssituationer, som samtidig giver dig et indblik i, hvordan det er at arbejde i Circle K.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Hos Circle K er der plads til alle og vi arbejder altid sammen som One team! Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på. Vi opfordrer derfor alle til at søge stillingen – uanset alder, køn, religion, handicap, etnisk baggrund etc.

skills.title: UAV Demonstration and Test Pilot – National & International (all genders)
skills.description:
STARK is a European defence technology company building the next generation of unmanned systems. We design, develop and manufacture software-defined, mass-scalable and cost-effective platforms that give NATO operators a decisive edge in highly contested environments. We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance capability — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, our work strengthens the technological edge of NATO Allies and their partners. Your mission is to fly our multirotor platforms flawlessly under real-world, high-visibility conditions, at home in Germany and internationally. You aren't just operating a quadcopter; you are the live proof of what our systems can do, and the first impression an audience forms of STARK's engineering. Demonstration Flight Execution
  • Plan and fly demonstration profiles on multirotor / quadcopter platforms with high precision and repeatability in front of live audiences.
  • Represent STARK's capabilities credibly and professionally to customers, partners, and military stakeholders during demonstrations and briefings.
  • Adapt flight profiles quickly to changing site conditions, audiences, and short-notice requests without compromising safety.
Deployment & Travel
  • Travel frequently to national and international demonstration sites, ranges, trade events, and customer locations.
  • Set up, configure, and pack down the demonstration kit independently, often on tight schedules and in unfamiliar environments.
  • Coordinate on site with event teams, customer representatives, and range control to ensure smooth, safe execution.
Preparation, Safety & Continuous Improvement
  • Perform pre-flight configurations, control-link verifications, and full functional system checks before every demonstration.
  • Lead airspace monitoring and deconfliction, and respond decisively to anomalies in line with established safety protocols and EASA requirements.
  • Feed observations from the field back into flight procedures, demonstration scripts, and platform improvements.
Experience & Certifications
  • Valid EASA A1/A3 (and optional A2) Remote Pilot Certificates.
  • Valid radio operator certificate (e.g., BZF) or willingness to obtain one.
  • Proven hands-on piloting experience on multirotor / quadcopter platforms, including manual and GCS-assisted flight.
  • Must be a citizen of a NATO member state (due to export control and security regulations).
Profile
  • High willingness to travel nationally and internationally, with flexible availability around demonstration schedules.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; German is an advantage.
  • Quick comprehension and a dynamic, adaptable working style — you get up to speed on new systems and situations fast.
  • Confident, composed presence in front of audiences and stakeholders.
Mindset & Style
  • Dynamic: You thrive under changing conditions and short-notice requests.
  • Representative: You understand that in a demonstration, you are STARK.
  • Precise: You deliver the same clean, controlled flight every single time, whatever the pressure.


  • FPV piloting experience.
  • Background in military UAV operations or the defence sector.
  • Additional languages relevant to international demonstrations.

For more details, please contact Sally Grütte-Pad, Interim Lead TA Partner via talent@stark-defence.com

skills.description:
We are WisdomAI.

We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.

WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.

We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.

About Wisdom

WisdomAI has the mission to provide access and insights from data to everyone. We believe in the power of data to drive better decisions and we believe with Generative AI, there is an opportunity to bring a disruptive change in how employees access insights within their organization. This is a great time to join the company as we have multiple Fortune100 companies as paying customers and still are early enough that you will get to define a lot of the product/engineering roadmap.

Role

We are looking for a backend/infrastructure engineer to join our founding team. We are working on building ML and data pipelines, which can be efficient, secure and highly scalable by design.

Job responsibilities

  • Build large scale data pipelines to handle latency critical analytical workloads.

  • Work with modern cloud infrastructure to build cost efficient and scalable systems.

  • Work closely with customers and founders to define the product and engineering roadmap.

  • Shape up the engineering culture and tech stack for the company.

Qualifications

  • Experience working on large scale data pipelines.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field.

  • Experience working in startup/fast paced teams is highly desirable.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Our CRAFT

CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.

C — Customer trust. Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.

R — Relentless on outcomes. We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.

A — Authenticity. We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.

F — First principles, grounded in reality. We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.

T — Transparency. We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Equal opportunity employer

WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

skills.title: Head of Programme - VK
skills.description:
Head of Programme (Customer Projects)

Our mission is to deliver clean, affordable energy for all. Our Small Modular Reactor (SMR) provides a British solution to a global energy challenge, and we are uniquely positioned to become a global leader in low-carbon nuclear energy, delivering a technology that will power generations to come.

Our Customer Projects team sits at the centre of some of the most significant energy infrastructure programmes in Europe. Working across design, licensing, procurement and construction planning, the team enables successful project delivery while shaping the future deployment of Rolls-Royce SMR technology internationally.

In this context, we are looking for a Head of Programme (Customer Projects) to support our Project Directors in delivering major international customer programmes. Reporting to the Project Director and leading integrated, matrixed delivery teams, this is a pivotal role that will help establish and deliver multi-billion-pound nuclear infrastructure projects from development through to Final Investment Decision.

We'll need you to:

  • Leading integrated programmes across design, licensing, procurement, construction planning and early site works activities.

  • Coordinating multidisciplinary teams across engineering, operations, supply chain, safety, regulatory and customer organisations to maintain delivery momentum and critical path.

  • Driving programme governance, risk management, dependency management, reporting and performance against schedule, cost and quality targets.

  • Building trusted operational relationships with customers, suppliers and international stakeholders to ensure successful programme execution and readiness for Final Investment Decision.

As you can see, this is a high-profile leadership opportunity where you'll bring commercial acumen, delivery focus and the ability to unite diverse teams behind a common objective in a fast-moving international environment.

We're looking for:

  • A degree in a STEM discipline (or equivalent experience) and chartered status with a recognised professional body such as APM, or equivalent demonstrable expertise.

  • Experience delivering complex major infrastructure, energy or nuclear programmes, particularly during development, design, licensing or pre-construction phases.

  • We'll ask you about your experience leading large, integrated programmes involving multiple stakeholders, contractors, regulators and customers.

  • Strong commercial awareness, including contract delivery, change management, programme governance and NEC contracting experience.

Location

This role can be based at any Rolls-Royce SMR location. We offer hybrid working, however reasonably frequent international travel will be required, particularly to support customer projects in the Czech Republic and Sweden, with travel expected for up to one week per month.

What's in it for me?

The salary for this role will be competitive and dependent on the experience, skills and knowledge you bring. Alongside a performance-related bonus, pension and flexible benefits package, you'll have the opportunity to play a leading role in delivering one of Europe's most ambitious clean energy programmes. You'll join a collaborative, innovative organisation committed to professional development, inclusion and long-term career growth.

We anticipate a great deal of interest in these roles and you may be asked to provide further examples and evidence of your experience and skills to enable us to refine a shortlist. We anticipate that we shall conduct first round interviews in the third week of August.




Pay Range:

£110,400.00

-

£144,900.00


Why Join Us?


You’ll be joining a forward-thinking organisation that values transparency, fairness, and innovation. We offer:


• A flexible, inclusive, and supportive working environment.
• Opportunities for career growth in a rapidly scaling business.
• A culture that values diversity, innovation, and continuous learning.


We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds. Inclusivity is important to us, and as a Disability Confident organisation, we are committed to fair, supportive, and continually improving recruitment practices that ensure everyone has the opportunity to thrive.


Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. If you feel you meet 75% of the requirements for this role, we would love to hear from you.


Also, if you are considering a career move or a sector-jump, please get in touch – we welcome applications from people with transferable skills.

Our Application Process

• Satisfactory completion of a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check
• Satisfactory completion of a basic financial probity check

35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with a minimum of 3 days per week to be worked at Head Office in Skipton

Salary:

£44,000 Per Annum

Closing Date:

Fri, 7 Aug 2026

Can you bring big ideas to life? Do you love turning insight, brand and visual thinking into creative work that people actually notice?

We’re looking for a Creative Design Lead to help shape how Skipton Building Society and the wider Skipton Group look, feel and communicate across print and digital channels. You’ll create compelling visual and conceptual work, combining strong creative craft with the kind of fresh thinking that helps a brand stand out.

This is a role for someone who can do more than make things look good. You’ll bring original ideas, challenge the obvious, and help raise the standard of creative work across the team. You’ll work from brief to delivery, creating campaigns, communications and design that feel on-brand, channel-appropriate and built around real people.

At Skipton, we're founded on fairness. We exist to do right by our members - and we believe that starts with doing right by our people. So whoever you are and whatever you bring, there's a place for you here and a genuine plan for where you go next.

What You’ll Do

Here in enabling Functions you’ll tackle big challenges, drive change and watch your career soar. You’ll be part of a team that keeps us running and you’ll have people from all corners of our business counting on you. Every idea you have, every process you improve helps support colleagues, support members to buy homes, and save for the future. None of it happens without you.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Generating original creative concepts and ideas, bringing a clear point of view to every brief

  • Developing visual ideas across print and digital channels, ensuring creative work stretches effectively across platforms and delivers impact in digital spaces

  • Working with the Creative Manager and other designers to help develop, evolve and embed our visual identity across the Skipton Group and Skipton Building Society brands

  • Presenting and explaining creative ideas clearly to senior stakeholders, building confidence through the strength of your thinking

  • Staying close to trends in advertising, design and culture, using your expertise to help grow our digital creative capability and raise creative standards across the team

What You’ll Need

  • Proven experience as a senior designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates both exceptional creative craft and conceptual thinking

  • Experience creating creative work within a regulated environment for established brands, where trust, reputation and customer outcomes matter as much as creativity

skills.title: Byggeleder til H.P. Christensen & Søn A/S

Vi tilbyder:

Om H.P. Christensen & Søn A/S

H.P. Christensen & Søn A/S er en VVS-virksomhed med hjemsted i Næstved, der løser opgaver inden for VVS-, varme- og klimainstallation for både private og erhverv. Virksomheden har eksisteret siden 1835 og har i dag omkring 40-50 medarbejdere.

skills.description:

Applications close: 21 August
Online interviews: late August
Assessment day: early September

As a seasonal Retail Experience Assistant, you will work on the shop floor
welcoming visitors, answering questions about products, processing transactions and ensuring the Shop runs smoothly during our busiest trading period. You will also help with stock management, visual presentation and supporting events or product demonstrations. Our aim is to work together to create an engaging, enlightening and enjoyable experience for every visitor to The Shop, so that everybody feels welcome and able to talk to our team.

You will support security and health & safety procedures, including managing visitor flow, being alert to hazards, and responding appropriately to any incidents.

Our approach to retail has been developed in line with the Japanese concept of Omotenashi:

“Translated simply, Omotenashi means the Japanese way of treating a guest. It blends a welcoming spirit with warmth, understanding, and above all respect.

The Japanese language makes no distinction between ‘guest’ and ‘customer.’ In English, the concept of ‘service’ suggests a hierarchy between the ‘server’ and the ‘customer.’ The Japanese Omotenashi, however, is based on a non-dominant relationship between equals – between the person offering the service (the host) and the person receiving it (the guest or customer).

To practice Omotenashi, the host pays close attention to detail and is committed to anticipating the needs of the guest, smiling sincerely and setting a happy, relaxed mood…”

Retail Experience

  • Engaging with visitors, enabling them to explore and enjoy the retail shop, by interpreting themes clearly and accurately.

Events and Other Activities

Essential

Desirable

skills.title: Søndersø botilbud i Maribo søger SSA uddannet medarbejder i fast aften
skills.description:
Har du mod på nye udfordringer og lysten til at arbejde med mennesker der har en hjerneskade og svære fysiske handicaps, så er et arbejde på Søndersø måske noget for dig?

Om Søndersø

Søndersø er et længerevarende botilbud, hvor borgerne har behov for omfattende hjælp til at mestre deres liv, på grund af betydelig nedsat kognitiv og fysisk funktionsevne.
Søndersø er organisatorisk tilknyttet Center for Socialpsykiatri og rusmidler, hvor vi er henhørende under Det Sociale tilsyn og Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed.

På Søndersø arbejder vi med afsæt i neurofaglige tilgange og metoder som er relevante i forhold til målgruppens særlige behov, hvilket vurderes at føre til positive resultater for borgerne. Vi arbejder ud fra en neuropædagogisk forståelseramme med henblik på at støtte det enkelte menneske i at kompensere for sine begrænsninger ved at udvikle nye strategier med afsæt i borgernes ressourcer.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en uddannet SSA-medarbejdere, som har lysten, evnerne og ikke mindst personligheden til at være ansat på Søndersø.

På Søndersø arbejder vi med en høj grad af selvstændighed og initiativ. Vi har en positiv tilgang til nye udfordringer og er ikke styret af regler men sund fornuft, og ser humor som et vigtigt element i det daglige arbejde.

Som SSA på Søndersø er du medicinansvarlig for dispensering af medicin, hvor du skal arbejde aktivt med FMK – fælles medicin kort. Herudover kommer din grundlæggende faglighed i stærkt samspil med dine kommende sundhedsfaglige og pædagogiske kollegaer.

På Søndersø får du bragt alle dine sundhedsfaglige kompetencer i spil, når du i dit daglige arbejde bl.a. møder sårpleje, lægesamtaler, risikolægemidler og dokumentation. Der er dets lige tæt samarbejde og sparring med Søndersøs sygeplejerske.

Kommunikationen er uformel og åben og vi lægger stor vægt på at man hele tiden udvikler sig fagligt og personligt. Fysisk og mentalt er det et job, hvor man bruger sig selv rigtig meget. I en aftenvagt går vi mange skridt, og der er brug for at have et godt overblik og stor rummelighed.

Vi dokumenterer i Nexus.

Vores forventninger

Som medarbejder skal du medvirke til at vedligeholde en kultur hvor tillid, respekt, anstændighed, inddragelse og anerkendelse er bærende elementer. Har du evnen og lysten til at løfte vores opgaver, så kan du være blandt dem vi søger, men det kræver, at du er klar til at gå på tværs af faggrænser og arbejdsopgaver og have en anerkendende og pædagogisk tilgang til enhver opgave omkring borgerne. Til gengæld har du i samarbejde med teamet indflydelse på at sætte dit præg på opgaverne.

Som aftenvagt på Søndersø vil du få ansvar som kontaktperson for 1-2 borgere, hvor alt fra personlig pleje, økonomi, nyt tøj, optiker og lægebesøg, samt meget mere er en del hverdagen.

Vores nye medarbejder skal være en selvstændige team-player og et menneske med stort M og hjertet på rette sted og skal kunne bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag. Vi ser gerne, at du er i besiddelse af et kørekort B og indstillet på at køre i vores busser.

Vil du vide mere

Hvis du har lyst til at læse mere om os, kan du følge dette link: Center for Socialpsykiatri, neuropædagogisk botilbud | tilbudsportalen.dk (tillidsportalen.dk).

Du er også meget velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Heidi Sørensen på tlf. +45 21 18 52 46, hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen.

Ansøgningsproces

Ansøgningsfristen er den 18. august 2026.

Samtaler forventes afholdt den. 28. august 2026.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst og principperne om lokal løndannelse.

Stillingen forventes indplaceret inden for et samlet løninterval på kr. 23.858 – 28.148 kr. månedligt ekskl. pension og tillæg. Hertil kommer pension på 14,00% og frit valg 1,29% samt eventuelle kvalifikations-, funktions- og genetillæg.

Aftenvagt 30 t. ugtl. I 5-2 ordning.

Stillingen er med arbejde hver anden weekend, samt på helligdage.

Stillingen er ledige til besættelse 1. oktober 2026.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning!

I Lolland Kommune arbejder omkring 3.500 medarbejdere hver dag for at skabe værdi for borgerne og udvikle kommunen. Medarbejderne er nøglen til udviklingen og til en arbejdsplads præget af dialog, åbenhed og nytænkning. Derfor investerer vi målrettet i kompetencer, nye arbejdsformer og stærke karrieremuligheder.

Med en placering tæt på Tyskland, Sjælland og Fyn er Lolland samtidig et attraktivt sted at bo. Her får du gode forbindelser til resten af landet, aktive lokalsamfund, idylliske købstæder og storslået natur. Her er plads til både arbejde og fritid – og til en hverdag, der hænger sammen.

Posted Job Title

Clinical Research Coordinator A/B

Job Profile Title

Clinical Research Coordinator A

Job Description Summary

This position will assist in the coordination of multiple research projects, which may include clinical trials and observational studies focused on lung transplantation. Tasks include but are not limited to screening of patients, obtaining informed consent, collection, processing and storage of biological samples, and collection and entry of patient reported data and clinical information from medical record review. The CRC will also work closely with the research team to accomplish study goals, identify problems and develop solutions.

Clinical Research Coordinator A: Coordinate and implement research projects focused on lung transplantation and disease. This includes but is not limited to:

skills.title: Founders Associate Intern – CEO Office (f/m/d)
skills.description:
QuantumDiamonds is looking for a sharp, driven Founders Associate Intern (m/f/d) to work directly alongside our founders in the CEO Office and help run one of Europe's most exciting deep-tech startups. This is not a support role at the edge of the action. You'll sit at the center of it, taking on the projects that matter most to the company at any given moment, from strategy and operations to fundraising prep, business development, and internal process building.

Your work will have real impact: our product and our whole company are evolving at breakneck speed, and we need someone who can take a messy problem, structure it, and drive it to a result. One week you might be building a financial model or preparing an investor update, the next you're untangling an operational bottleneck or take on responsibility to ship a tool to a Asia. This is a rare opportunity for a generalist who wants genuine responsibility, broad exposure to how a company is actually built, and a front-row seat next to the founders. If you are ambitious, hands on, and want to learn faster than anywhere else, this is the right role for you. Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale, and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Picture this:
  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.
  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.
  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.
  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.
Still unsure about why joining us?
  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.
  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how QuantumDiamonds runs and grows.
  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.
  • Sitting in the CEO Office, you'll have real responsibility, a voice that counts, and the chance to shape how we operate as we scale.
  • You'll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.
Let's see what others can't! Most importantly: Jump on whatever matters most right now, acting as a flexible right hand to the founders on high-priority topics.
  • Take full ownership of cross-functional projects that land on the founders' desk, from framing the problem to delivering the result.
  • Prepare board and investor materials, updates, and presentations, and support fundraising and reporting processes end to end.
  • Build structure where there is none by designing and improving internal processes, tools, and workflows as we scale.
  • Build financial models, dashboards, and business cases to support key decisions.
  • Partner directly with technical, commercial, and leadership teams (including the CEO) to move priorities forward and unblock the team.
  • Support hiring and organizational topics, helping us attract and onboard the talent we need to grow.
  • Currently pursuing or holding a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Physics, or a related field, ideally with strong academic results.
  • Excellent structured thinking and problem-solving skills: you can break down ambiguous problems and drive them to a result.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with numbers, data, and tools like Excel and slides.
  • Written and verbal communication skills in English and German.
  • An ownership mentality: you take initiative, drive topics end to end, and want real responsibility and influence rather than just supporting others.
  • A hands-on attitude and genuine comfort working in a fast-paced startup where priorities evolve quickly.
  • An interest in deep tech, science, or hard technology businesses, plus the curiosity to learn how a company is really built.
  • First experience in consulting, VC, startups, or a founder's team is a plus, but not a must.
  • Curiosity, resourcefulness, and enthusiasm for learning.
  • Mission: At QD, we're driven by more than just building great products, we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.
  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You'll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that's scaling fast.
  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you'll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.
  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you'll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

skills.title: Vandløbsstilling i Vordingborg Kommune
skills.company: Center for Vej Natur og Miljø
skills.description:
Vil du være med til at finde fremtidens løsninger til håndtering af vand og naturforbedrende tiltag i vores vand- og vådområder i Vordingborg Kommune – så er du måske den nye vandløbsmedarbejder vi leder efter.

Som vandløbsmedarbejder vil du skulle arbejde med at få mange hensyn til at gå hånd i hånd. Det være sig afvanding, vandløbsprojekter til sikring af god økologisk tilstand i vores vandområder samt arbejdet med vådområder under den Grønne Trepart og klimasikring.

Der kommer mere og mere vand ovenfra, og afvanding af marker og beboelsesområder skal sikres. Det reguleres bl.a. gennem vandløbsloven, og kommunen har myndighedsopgaven med at sikre at både egne og private dræn og vandløb fungerer. Både på kort sigt og i fremtiden med scenarier med mere vand. Det er et spændene og udfordrende arbejde, som kræver gode evner ud i kommunikation og dialog med lodsejere.

Der er i dag et stort fokus på genopretning af vores våde natur, og gennemføre vandløbsrestaurering. Vi vil også gerne opdatere vandløbsregulativerne set i sammenhæng med udviklingen af projekter under den Grønne Trepart. Vi har mange interessante projekter i gang på forskellige stadier, som kræver struktur og det gode overblik. Ligeledes er det vigtigt at have øje for synergieffekter, så du optimerer og får mest muligt ud af projekterne.

Vi søger derfor en medarbejder, der vil lægge kræfter i arbejdet med administrationen af hhv. vandløbsloven, opdatering af vandløbsregulativer og vandplanprojekter.

Vores nye medarbejder bliver knyttet til Vandløbsgruppen, hvor også arbejdet med den Grønne Trepart er placeret.

Vi forventer at du:
  • Har en relevant uddannelse, som f.eks. biolog, jordbrugsteknolog, skov- og landskabsingeniør eller lign.
  • Har erfaring med vandløbsloven og gerne også arbejdet med revision af vandløbsregulativer.
  • Har erfaring med myndighedsrollen eller gerne vil blive dygtig til en af kommunens vigtigste kerneopgaver: myndighedsarbejde og sagsbehandling af projekter under den grønne trepart.
  • Er åben for at søge nye veje og måder at håndtere udfordringerne med mere vand og behovet for klimasikring i fremtiden i en helhedsorienteret tankegang.
  • Skriver godt og kan formidle svært stof til forskellige modtagere.
  • Har flair for god servicering af borgere eller andre eksterne samarbejdspartnere.
  • Er god til og minded for samarbejde i gruppen, på tværs af grupperne i afdelingen og i organisationen, samt med eksterne parter.

Opgaver der umiddelbart står for at skulle løftes i vandløbsgruppen er:
  • Sagsbehandling efter vandløbsloven, herunder drænsager, brogodkendelser, krydsningstilladelser og reguleringssager
  • Løfte og finde løsninger på en række større og langvarige sager på drænområdet
  • Myndighedsbehandling af grøntrepartpartsprojekter
  • Vandløbsprojekter, herunder vandløbsregulering og -restaurering
  • Indgå i den daglige drift i vandløbsgruppen

Ansættelsessted
Natur og Miljø, herunder vandløbsgruppen har midlertidigt til huse i Præstø sammen med en del af de andre teams på det tekniske område. I løbet af 2026 flytter alt det administrative personale til det nye rådhus i Vordingborg. Med arbejdspladsen centralt placeret i Vordingborg centrum bliver adgangen med offentlig transport nemmere.

Ansættelsesforhold
Stillingen er på fuld tid – 37 timer om ugen – og tidsbegrænset til tre år med mulighed for forlængelse.

Yderligere information
For yderlige information er du er velkommen til at kontakte teamleder for Natur og Vand, Pernille Sørensen på tlf. 23617609 /perso@vordingborg.dk.

Ansøgning og ansættelsesprocessen
Ansøgning og CV uploades senest den 21. august 2026. Samtaler forventes at finde sted i uge 35 og 36.

Vordingborg Kommune ønsker at fremme ligestilling og mangfoldighed. Vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge stillingerne - uanset etnisk baggrund, køn, seksuel orientering, handicap, religion eller alder.

Vordingborg Kommune

Vordingborg Kommune er en attraktiv og moderne arbejdsplads beliggende i Danmarks vildeste natur. Her langs Danmarks længste kystlinje mellem historiske købstæder og stærke fællesskaber er vi omtrent 4000 ansatte, der arbejder for at gøre vores kommune til et endnu mere grønt og attraktivt sted at bo og leve.

Vi har fokus på, at hverdagen skal hænge sammen og tilbyder rammerne om et liv i balance. Her får du mange kvadratmeter for færre penge, du kommer tæt på kysten, i spektakulær natur – med et meningsfuldt job. Så kom og vær med!

Fri, 7 Aug 2026

Join us at the forefront of credit risk modelling, where you'll lead the development and ongoing evolution of predictive models that help shape strategic decisions and ensure regulatory compliance. From IRB to IFRS 9, your expertise will be instrumental in assessing credit losses across our residential mortgage portfolio.

What You’ll Do
