tags.description:
The Opportunity:

The Department of Health Sciences in the College of Health Professions and Sciences (CHPS) at the University of Central Florida (UCF) invites applications for a 9-month, non-tenure earning, instructor or lecturer position. The position is open to master’s and doctoral level Registered Dietitian Nutritionists who hold valid credentials through the commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR). The preferred start date is as early as January 2027, but no later than August 2027.

We are seeking a dynamic and collaborative faculty member to support undergraduate education and the development, implementation and ongoing operation of a newly approved Master of Science in Nutrition Science and Dietetics, with the goal of achieving ACEND candidacy as a Nutrition and Dietetics Coordinated Program (CP).

The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Teach undergraduate and/or graduate courses in nutrition and related areas using evidence based, student centered instructional approaches.

  • Develop graduate courses with content specific to program needs using evidence-based, student-centered teaching approaches.

  • Supervise and evaluate students during supervised experiential learning (SEL) across diverse practice settings.

  • Foster and maintain partnerships with healthcare systems, community organizations, food and nutrition service providers, preceptors and other stakeholders to support high-quality experiential learning opportunities.

  • Contribute to student recruitment and mentoring.

  • Pursue ongoing professional development to maintain currency in nutrition and dietetics practice, education, and competency-based learning models.

  • Contribute to a collaborative, student focused academic environment.

  • Engage in scholarly activities, service, and professional development.

    Minimum Qualifications:

    • Master’s degree (for an instructor) or doctorate, Ph.D. or equivalent (for a lecturer) in human nutrition/dietetics or a closely related discipline from an accredited academic institution at the time of application.

    • Credentialed as a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) by the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).

    • Minimum 4 years full-time professional practice post-CDR credentialing with experience providing patient care in hospital, rehabilitation, or long-term care facilities or managing food service operations.

    Preferred Qualifications:

    • Experience applying advanced clinical nutrition skills as a member of an interdisciplinary team caring for medically complex patients in a hospital, rehabilitation, or long-term care facility or directing food service operations in these facilities.

    • Teaching, preferably in an academic setting or mentoring students in professional practice.

    • Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.

    • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders.

    Additional Application Materials Required:
    UCF requires all applications and supporting documents to be submitted electronically through the Human Resources employment opportunities website, https://www.ucf.edu/jobs/. In addition to the online application, candidates will be required to upload the following documents:

    • Cover letter outlining your qualifications and how they align with and support success in this position’s roles and responsibilities.

    • Curriculum vitae

    • Teaching philosophy

    NOTE: Please have all documents ready when applying so they can be simultaneously uploaded. Only applications that contain all required materials will be considered. Once the online submission process is finalized, the system does not allow applicants to submit additional documents later.

    The selected candidate will be required to submit a list of references and official transcripts (and, as applicable, U.S. degree equivalency evaluations) documenting the conferral of their qualifying academic credentials.

    Questions regarding this search should be directed to: Dr. Cheryl Cavaliere (cheryl.cavaliere@ucf.edu).

    Special Instructions to the Applicants:

    Sponsorship for employment-based visas will only be considered under exceptional circumstances and is not guaranteed. Preference will be given to candidates who are currently authorized to work for any employer in the United States.

    This is a face-to-face on campus faculty position. Instructions will be delivered primarily in person at the main Orlando campus.

    Job Close Date:

    Open until filled.

    Note to applicants: Please keep in mind that a job posted as ‘Open until filled’ may close at any time without notice. As such, we encourage you to submit your application and all required documentation as quickly as possible to ensure consideration for the posted position. Only candidates that submit all required materials will be considered for the position.

    Are you ready to unleash YOUR potential?

    As a next-generation public research university and Forbes-ranked top employer in Florida, we are a community of thinkers, doers, creators, innovators, healers, and leaders striving to create broader prosperity and help shape a better future. No matter what your role is, when you join Knight Nation, you’ll play an integral role at one of the most impactful universities in the country. You’ll be met with opportunities to connect and collaborate with talented faculty, staff, and students across 12 colleges and multiple campuses, engaging in impactful work that makes a positive difference. Your time at UCF will provide you with many meaningful opportunities to grow, you’ll work alongside talented colleagues on complex projects that will challenge you and help you gain new skills and you’ll have countless rewarding experiences that go well beyond a paycheck.

    • And more…For more benefits information, view the UCF Employee Benefits Guide click here.

Applicants subject to additional screening include any citizen of a foreign country who is not a permanent resident of the U.S., or who is a citizen or permanent resident but is affiliated with or has had at least 1 year of education, employment, or training in China, Cuba, Iran, Russia, North Korea, Syria, or Venezuela.

Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.
About Binance Accelerator Program
Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.
Who may apply
Current university students and recent graduates.
*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws

About the Role

We are building cutting-edge AI systems that enable the next generation of intelligent applications. Our team focuses on developing AI agents, benchmarking datasets, and robust infrastructure to support real-world deployments at scale. As part of our engineering-driven culture, you'll be exposed to a fast-paced environment where experimentation, collaboration, and innovation are encouraged.

Responsibilities

- Contribute to the design and development of AI agents integrated into live systems.
- Help build and maintain benchmark datasets to evaluate AI performance.
- Implement, test, and optimize backend services in Python or Golang.
- Collaborate closely with senior engineers on system design, multi-agent orchestration, and deployment
- Participate in code reviews, debugging, and documentation to ensure best practices.
- Work in a team environment that encourages mentorship, knowledge sharing, and hands-on learning

Requirements

- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
- Strong programming fundamentals — language-agnostic, but practical experience with at least one of Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar
- Solid understanding of software engineering principles (data structures, algorithms, version control)
- Familiarity or working knowledge of any AI agent framework (e.g., OpenClaw, hermes-agent, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen)
- Interest in AI, data-driven systems, and building tools for real-world applications
- Good communication skills and willingness to learn quickly

What We're Looking For (Culture & Mindset)

- AI-native working style — you naturally reach for AI tools in your daily workflow, not as an afterthought but as a core part of how you think, build, and solve problems
- Eager to learn and open-minded — you stay current with the latest technologies and aren't afraid to adopt new frameworks, tools, or paradigms before they're mainstream
- First-principles thinker who's comfortable redesigning workflows rather than just optimizing existing ones

Nice to Haves

- Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or building tools on top of AI models
- Exposure to multi-agent systems or agent orchestration patterns
- Familiarity with Docker, cloud platforms, or CI/CD pipelines
- Machine learning knowledge is a plus, but not required

Why Binance
• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.
By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

- Experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help optimize data workflows.

tags.title: UI Product Designer
tags.description:
About the Position:

Are you a problem-solver who happens to use design as your primary tool? AvePoint is looking for a Product Designer to join our global team. While we value high-quality visual execution, this role is centered on understanding complex workflows and translating them into intuitive, functional experiences.

If you are someone who asks "Why?" before "How?", thrives on user data, and can articulate the logic behind every pixel, we want to talk to you. You will be a key bridge between our US-based strategy and global execution.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Designer at AvePoint, you won’t just be "skinning" interfaces; you’ll be architecting solutions. Your responsibilities include:

  • Logic-First Design: Translate complex business requirements into logical user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes that prioritize ease of use over mere decoration.
  • Data-Driven Iteration: Use insights from user research, heatmaps, and analytics to identify friction points and propose design-led solutions.
  • Design System Governance: Contribute to and maintain our global design system, ensuring every component is reusable, accessible, and scalable.
  • Proactive Collaboration: Work asynchronously with US-based Product Managers. You will be expected to document your design rationale clearly so the team understands the thinking behind the designs.
  • Usability Advocacy: Participate in (and eventually lead) usability testing sessions, synthesizing feedback into actionable design improvements.
  • Technical Partnership: Collaborate closely with developers to ensure that "pixel-perfect" designs are technically feasible and implemented with high fidelity.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • The "Product" Mindset: 3+ years of experience in UX/UI or Product Design, preferably within B2B SaaS or complex enterprise environments.
  • Strategic Communication: Ability to present and defend design decisions to stakeholders in a clear, professional manner. You aren't afraid to push back if a design isn't in the user's best interest.
  • Mastery of Tools: Expert-level proficiency in Figma (including advanced prototyping, auto-layout, and components).
  • Research Literacy: A solid understanding of user-centered design methodologies and experience turning raw research into user journeys and personas.
  • Self-Direction: The ability to work independently during PH hours while maintaining high alignment with a US-based team.
  • Portfolio Evidence: A portfolio that showcases your process—not just the final UI, but the sketches, wireframes, and "failed" versions that led to the final solution.

Bonus Points for:

  • Understanding of Web Accessibility (WCAG 2.1) standards.
  • Knowledge of HTML/CSS constraints (you don't need to code, but you should know what’s hard to build).
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment using Jira or Azure DevOps.

What’s in it for you?

  • HMO coverage from day 1 of employment (plus 2 free dependents)
  • Group life insurance (upon regularization)
  • Wellness Reimbursement Program (upon regularization)
  • Paid annual and sick leaves (convertible into cash)
  • Paid compassionate leave (5 days)
  • Employee Dedication Award (years of service)
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program
  • Promoting diversity and inclusion
  • Business Travel Opportunity (Top Performers)
  • Hybrid Working Arrangement (3 days onsite & 2 days work-from-home)
  • Competitive compensation package, Performance bonuses/incentives
  • Career growth & advancement opportunities

AvePoint is proud to employ talent from many different backgrounds, experiences, and identities. We believe that diversity and inclusion drives our success and is at the core of how we hire, communicate, and collaborate to deliver value and excellence. We are committed to fostering an environment where people can bring their whole selves to work and feel a sense of belonging, and we continue to work toward creating a workforce that represents the diversity of our customers and communities.

skills.description:
ABOUT ORACLE CLOUD

Oracle Cloud is the first public cloud built from the ground up to be a better cloud for every application. By rethinking core engineering and systems design for cloud computing, we created innovations that solve problems that customers have with existing public clouds.

We accelerate migrations of existing enterprise workloads, deliver better reliability and performance for all applications, and offer the complete services customers need to build innovative cloud applications. There are six key reasons customers are choosing Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) for all their cloud workloads.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Oracle Cloud’s Government, Defence, and Intelligence team is a smart, motivated, and diverse group that is focused on bringing the world’s most important work to OCI. We build and operate our government, classified, and sovereign cloud regions to be reliable and high-performance, just like our public cloud. Our customers and their mission are the center of what we do. We strive to improve our knowledge of the challenges our customers face which we use to enhance our cloud capabilities and work together to deliver their mission.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We're looking for a Senior Technical Operations Engineer responsible for the operation of production environments, including systems and databases, supporting critical business operations. You will perform administration and analysis for multiple production environments and recommend new and novel solutions to improve availability, performance, and supportability.

This is an opportunity to bring a combination of deep technical knowledge with administration/analysis knowledge of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure to provide escalation support to a wide range of complex production environment problems related to immense growth, scaling, leveraging the cloud, extremely high performance, and high availability requirements. As a Senior Technical Operations Engineer, you will also guide junior engineers to solve complex problems, take part in large-scale incident bridges and help to build new processes and procedures.

OCI IN <LOCATION>

As cloud investment in Northern Ireland continues to grow, companies and governments are moving more mission critical workloads to cloud, and Oracle is ensuring full support to our customers with our offerings. Oracle Cloud Isolated Regions (OCIR) are secure, air-gapped Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) solutions designed to meet the higher demands of global customers’ mission-critical classified workloads. These regions provide all OCI public cloud services (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS) in a physical location of the customer's choosing, supported and operated by dedicated personnel.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Install, monitor, maintain, support, and optimize all production server hardware and software.

  • Provide technical support for complex technical issues which may include leading problem management cases and providing management status.

  • Coordinate escalated support cases and lead appropriate internal technical resources and/or third-party vendors to resolution and coordinate a storage infrastructure of Oracle system and database appliances.

  • Responsible for Oracle production environments; assist with server operating system and application upgrades, bug fixes, and patching; and work on standardization projects for both hardware and software under the Oracle technology stack while providing consistent system uptime as expected in a Cloud environment.

  • This team will provide support and administration on a 24/7 basis and will require rotation across day and night shifts.

REQUIREMENTS

  • This role is open to Northern Ireland nationals only.

  • This role will involve the successful applicant working on government projects which may require security clearance being obtained and maintained as a condition of employment. Candidates applying for this role must be willing to provide necessary personal details for the application and maintenance of necessary security clearance.

  • Experience with Linux System Administration, Kubernetes, Cloud, Exadata, Networking, Database, Storage, Compute, Virtualization and Troubleshooting

  • An understanding of infrastructure as code tooling.

  • Experience participating in or running incident bridges.

  • Customer focus, with a passion for delighting customers.

  • Experience in cloud technical support, operations, incident management is preferred, but not required.

  • Demonstrate ability to quickly learn new technical disciplines and then train others.

OR

A Printpack QA Technician I ensures that Printpack’s products are produced in specification and meet customer requirements. skills.title: Pædagog med interesse for specialpædagogik søges til Børnehuset Kregme
skills.description:
En af vores dygtige pædagoger har valgt at fortsætte sin faglige rejse på skoleområdet i Halsnæs Kommune. Derfor søger vi nu en engageret pædagog til vores børnehave.

Hos os får du mulighed for at blive en del af et fagligt stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for, at alle børn oplever at høre til, udvikle sig og have en meningsfuld plads i fællesskabet. Vi tror på, at børn udvikler sig bedst, når de mødes med tydelighed, nærvær og voksne, der er nysgerrige på, hvad der optager dem, og hvad de har brug for.

Det er vigtigt, at barnet kommer til at tro på sig selv og oplever at have betydning for sine omgivelser. Det giver så meget tilbage til mig som pædagog, at vi kan bidrage til netop dét.

Hos os får du:
  • Et Børnehus og et område i løbende udvikling
  • Fagligt funderede og engagerede kolleger at indgå i refleksivt samarbejde med
  • Stor optagethed af at skabe mellemformer, som styrker børns inddragelse i fællesskaber og tilbyder passende udfordringer
  • Høj grad af indflydelse på den pædagogiske praksis og frihed under ansvar
  • Stort fokus på et stærkt og inddragende forældresamarbejde
  • Løbende systematisk understøttelse af et arbejdsmiljø med høj social kapital og psykologisk tryghed
Vi mangler dig, der
  • Har interesse for, og gerne erfaring med, specialpædagogik i dagtilbud og er åben for, hvad det betyder i mødet med det enkelte barn. Du ved, at tydelighed, struktur og et ressourceorienteret børnesyn er afgørende for at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn.
  • Er optaget af at tilpasse læringsmiljøet til både børnegruppen og det enkelte barn, og arbejder derfor helt naturligt med mindre børnegrupper.
  • Du har lyst til at være tæt på børnene, du er baseværdig og kan positionere dig dér, hvor der er brug for dig. Forældresamarbejdet ser du som en vigtig del af opgaven, og du trives i et tæt samarbejde om barnets udvikling og trivsel.
  • Du har mod på de situationer, der kan bøvle, og du møder konflikter og udfordringer med en handlekraftig og løsningsorienteret tilgang.
  • Samtidig er du engageret, initiativrig og nysgerrig på både din egen og fællesskabets faglige udvikling.

Hos os er "plejer" sjældent et argument i sig selv, og vi justerer gerne rammer og pædagogiske greb, når det skaber bedre muligheder for trivsel og udvikling. Vi er inspirerede af NEST og anvender aktivt piktogrammer, Time-timere og andre hjælpemidler i arbejdet med børnegrupperne.

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra dag ét. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, udvikle dig fagligt og bidrage aktivt til vores fælles arbejde med at skabe gode børneliv.

Når man ser børn udvikle sig, være glade og nysgerrige, er det fantastisk at være den pædagog, der kan være et skridt foran og give det næste lille skub.

Børnehuset Kregme – kort fortalt

Børnehuset Kregme ligger i udkanten af Frederiksværk i et område med meget nybyggeri og mange nye børnefamilier. Vi holder til i et stort, lyst og moderne hus med en stor legeplads og mange muligheder for leg, læring og fællesskab.

Vi er normeret til 60 børnehavebørn og fra 1. oktober 50 vuggestuebørn. Huset er organiseret i 8 stuer fordelt på 4 teams.

Vi har eget køkken, hvor der hver dag laves sund mad til børnene (økologisk sølvmærke). Derudover har vi en leder, en daglig pædagogisk leder, ressourcepædagoger i både børnehave og vuggestue samt en sprogansvarlig medarbejder, der understøtter arbejdet med børnenes sproglige udvikling.

Derfor skal du søge hos os
  • Vi er et børnehus i bevægelse med højt til loftet og plads til pædagogisk udfoldelse
  • Vi rummer hinandens forskelligheder og er gode til at se det som fordele frem for ulemper
  • Vi er gode til at hjælpe hinanden, og faglig sparring er en naturlig del af hverdagen
  • Vi er fagligt dygtige og nysgerrige på egen og hinandens pædagogiske praksis
  • Vi inspireres af ny viden og formår hurtigt at omsætte den til praksis
  • Vi er en fleksibel arbejdsplads, hvor der er gode muligheder for medbestemmelse i forhold til skema og timetal
Praktisk information

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt med mulighed for justering, og vi håber, at du kan starte 1. oktober 2026 eller hurtigst muligt derefter.

Ansøgningsfrist: tirsdag den 19. august kl. 12.00.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning.

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen eller om Børnehuset Kregme, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Leder Bjørk Kuhn Jeppesen 2159 3104

Daglig pædagogisk leder Line Jordoson 2933 9959 (fra uge 33)

Bliv en del af Halsnæs – et godt sted at arbejde og et godt sted at bo

Vi er en moderne og rummelig arbejdsplads med cirka 3.000 kollegaer, der hver dag gør sig umage for at levere velfærd og service af høj kvalitet. Vores værdier – redelighed, mulighed og helhed – er fundamentet for alt, vi gør.

Hos Halsnæs Kommune arbejder vi tæt på natur, hav og fjord – og med hovedstaden inden for rækkevidde. Her får du ikke kun et spændende job, men også muligheden for at skabe et liv med ro, fællesskab og aktive oplevelser. Mange vælger at bosætte sig her for at få mere plads, nærhed til naturen og et stærkt lokalt sammenhold.

Vil du vide mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde i Halsnæs Kommune? Besøg vores hjemmeside eller vores LinkedIn-profil.
Vil du vide mere om, hvordan det er at bo og leve i Halsnæs? Besøg Flyt til Halsnæs og se, hvad området kan tilbyde dig og din familie.

skills.title: Incident Manager
skills.description:
We are the leading Tech Company in Europe, supporting digital innovation for over 45 years. We are committed to bringing digital technology into every business. How? By putting customers first and becoming the go-to partner for professionals, small, medium, and large companies, offering customized solutions and services to optimize business processes—from HR and customer relations to e-invoicing and digital payments.

The Group Technology area is the beating heart of the Group's innovation. Within Group Technology, the Tech Excellence function is responsible for driving the highest standards across Security, Quality, Cost Management and Project Management. Our mission is to ensure that the Group’s technological landscape is not only innovative but also resilient, efficient and reliable.

In this context, we are seeking an Incident Manager to join the Tech Excellence team. This is a newly created, strategic role designed to take ownership of the incident management lifecycle, bridging the gap between technical recovery and corporate governance.

The primary mission of this role is to design, implement and govern a robust Incident Management framework from the ground up. You will serve as the central orchestrator during critical events, ensuring that our products - the backbone of our customers' business - maintain the highest levels of availability and trust. You will transition our response capabilities from reactive to a standardized, continuous improvement model.

You will be responsible for:

  • Improving the Incident Management framework: proactively review and implement the end-to-end incident management operating model, focusing on clear workflows, severity levels and escalation paths across the entire product portfolio.

  • Orchestrating Cross-Functional Response: lead the coordination of diverse stakeholders—including Technical Teams, Product Owners, DPO, Legal, Cybersecurity, and Customer Success—during major incidents, ensuring a unified and effective response.

  • Driving Continuous Improvement: facilitate structured post-mortem analyses and "blameless" root cause reviews to translate incidents into actionable technical and process improvements.

  • Proactive Prevention & Risk Mitigation: develop and manage prevention policies and trend-monitoring systems to identify systemic risks, aiming to significantly reduce incident frequency and impact.

skills.title: Financial Controller
skills.description:
Job Overview

The Financial Controller is responsible for delivering accurate and timely management reporting, coordinating month-end close activities, and supporting strategic financial decision-making. The person in this role will work closely with accounting, operations and sales teams to ensure reliable financial information, contribute to budgeting and forecasting processes, and develop analytical tools to support business objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare management reports, including profit and loss statements, key performance indicators (KPI) and ad hoc analyses.
  • Coordinate the month-end closing process to ensure completeness and accuracy of management information.
  • Develop, maintain and control budgets and forecasts; monitor variances and provide explanations.
  • Analyze sales, margins and cost structures to identify trends and support performance improvement.
  • Monitor progress against business targets and report on deviations and corrective actions.
  • Prepare financial forecasts and business scenario analyses to support planning and strategic initiatives.
  • Support investment decisions through return on investment (ROI) and net present value (NPV) analyses.
  • Review management-level accounting entries for accuracy and consistency with reporting standards.
  • Collaborate with accounting, operations and sales teams to ensure alignment of financial information and business processes.
  • Prepare documentation and data required for audits and liaise with external auditors as needed.
  • Develop and enhance reporting tools and dashboards using Excel, Power BI and other BI systems.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and support of efficiency measures.

Qualifications

  • Degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience in a controlling, financial analysis or management reporting role.
  • Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling techniques.
  • Practical experience with month-end close processes and management accounting principles.
  • Proficiency in Excel; experience with Power BI and other BI systems is highly desirable.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail and ability to present complex information clearly.
  • Effective communication skills and experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Fluency in the local language and professional working proficiency in English are advantageous.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with role and experience.
  • Opportunities for professional development and advancement within the organisation.
  • Access to modern reporting tools and support for analytical skill development.
  • Collaborative environment with close interaction across finance, operations and sales functions

skills.title: Public Transport Technician
skills.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

As a Senior Product Manager in the Global Merchant Database team, your mission is to own and evolve a core platform that sits at the heart of the company’s ecosystem. You will lead the development of products that manage merchant data, product catalogues, pricing models, and agreements - enabling teams across the business to build reliable, scalable, and secure merchant-facing experiences.This is a platform and technical product role, working with a highly cross-functional set of internal stakeholders. You will act as the product owner for APIs, event-driven systems, and authorization models that underpin how merchant data is accessed and used across the company.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for key platform capabilities within the Global Merchant Database

  • Act as the product owner for merchant data APIs and event interfaces, treating APIs as first-class products

  • Work closely with engineering to define clear, scalable API contracts, event schemas, and data models

  • Ensure backward compatibility, versioning, and deprecation strategies are thoughtfully planned and communicated

  • Partner with internal teams to understand their needs and translate them into platform capabilities, not one-off solutions

  • Define and evolve authorization and access control models for merchant data, balancing security, compliance, and usability

  • Collaborate with design, engineering, marketing, operations, security, and legal teams to bring solutions to life

  • Translate complex technical and business requirements into clear, actionable product requirements

  • Prioritise ruthlessly based on platform impact, adoption, and long-term scalability

  • Define platform success metrics (e.g. adoption, reliability, performance, time-to-integrate) and continuously optimise post-launch

  • Support the coordination and integration of multiple new products each year, ensuring a reliable, intelligent merchant data foundation

  • Champion documentation excellence, including API documentation, changelogs, migration guides, and internal product RFCs

  • Act as a strong internal advocate for platform thinking, consistency, and simplicity

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ Years in a Product Manager Role

  • Solid understanding of how REST APIs work (and awareness of other integration patterns)

  • Hands-on experience testing APIs using tools such as Postman or similar

  • Experience working with event-driven systems and defining product-level event semantics

  • Ability to reason about system design trade-offs (sync vs async, scalability, reliability) from a product perspective

  • Understanding of data modeling, data types, and schema evolution

  • Basic SQL knowledge and comfort working with data directly

  • Familiarity with DDD concepts from a product perspective (domains, bounded contexts, ownership)

  • Experience defining authorization and access control models (e.g. roles, scopes, policies) in multi-tenant systems

The Perks

  • Flexible working hours, built on trust and collaboration with your team

  • Physical and mental health support through Wellhub, including access to 1,500+ gyms, 1-1 therapy, meditation, and wellbeing apps

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave options

  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme

  • Health and Life Insurance

  • Pension Scheme

  • 25 days of Annual Leave (+ Bank Holidays)

  • Office snacks every day

  • Friendly, comfortable, and informal office environment in Central London

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

tags.description:
Organisation: Leicestershire County Council

Work Location: County Hall, Glenfield, Leicester, LE3 8RA

Salary: £25,191 - £25,590 per annum (pro-rata for part-time) (Pay award pending)

Working Hours: 37 hours per week

Contract Type: Permanent

Closing Date: 6th August 2026

Interview Date(s): Week commencing 31st August 2026 (TBC)

We are looking to recruit a full time Public Transport Technician to join the Sustainable Travel Team. This role will support the delivery of improvements to public transport in the county.

Leicestershire has a good commercial bus network, complemented by local bus services tendered by the Sustainable Travel Team including FoxConnect and taxi-based demand responsive transport services.

There are approximately 3,400 active bus stops and more than 800 bus shelters across the county.

Additional government funding will further support improvements to public transport information and infrastructure.

About the Role

A key part of this role is to carry out a range of administrative tasks along with maintaining and monitoring bus stop infrastructure and public transport information provision.

This role requires working independently in a lone working environment. Many of the tasks involve outdoor working and in all weather conditions. The successful post holder will be provided with a vehicle to undertake the duties of this post and will be required to conduct daily checks and inspections to ensure it is kept in a roadworthy condition. The postholder will need to comply with all Health and Safety legislation, safe systems of work, risk assessments, traffic management requirements to ensure personal safety and that of the general public and colleagues.

Main Duties

  • Install and display roadside public transport information - install new flags, cases and town boards to poles and lamp columns and insert displays as relevant and replace/repair existing facilities such as perspex front sheets and information displays.
  • To audit and inspect bus stops facilities including bus stop flags, shelters, hard standing and timetable cases.
  • Input and update information gathered into databases and spreadsheets.
  • Assist with the collection, manipulation and analysis of bus service data as required.

Assist in the preparation and production of roadside publicity materials such as notices, timetables and waysides.

About You

To apply for this post, you must:

  • Qualifications - Have NVQ Level 2 (or equivalent) or English and Maths GCSE at Grade A-C or equivalent OR have demonstrable work experience in a public facing environment
  • Hold a valid full driving licence (Applicants with more than 5 penalty points will not be considered)
  • Have experience of using Microsoft Word and Excel or equivalent packages sufficient to input and organise data. Good numerical and attention to detail ability.
  • Have experience of using manual and power tools e.g. drills, metal banding equipment to secure bus stop flags. Need to be physically able to meet mobility-related duties e.g. fixing timetable cases and flags to poles; lifting equipment such as display cases.
  • Have good awareness of Health & Safety issues and processes relevant to highway working. Must be willing to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and use other safety equipment.
  • To be self-motivated, able to work with minimal supervision and a demonstrable ability to use own initiative. Ability to plan and prioritise own workload.
  • Have good geographical knowledge of the County. Ability to work flexibly, which may involve out of hours working.

In addition, we also expect you to share our commitment to our values and to delivering accessible and inclusive services which meet the needs of all of our residents. You will be asked to demonstrate your understanding of these commitments as part of the selection process.

Reasonable adjustments will be considered for applicants with a disability. We are a Disability Confident Employer.

Interested in Flexible Working?

We are open to discussions about flexible working, which may include part time working, job sharing, term-time working, flexible start and finish times, and hybrid working, depending on the requirements of the role and the service. If you would like to discuss the possible flexible working options that might be applicable to this role, please contact the person named below.

For more information or an informal discussion, please contact:

Hina Gadhia

Sustainable Travel Manager

Hina.gadhia@leics.gov.uk

0116 3057356

How to Apply

At Leicestershire County Council we’re looking for top talent from all walks of life. Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, and whatever your background - we care about what you bring to our organisation, not just what’s on your CV. That’s why we’ve designed a recruitment process that’s fair, accessible, and focused on potential. Without this information, we won’t be able to assess your suitability for the role, and your application will be rejected. For tips on how to write your statement, see the How to Apply section on our career site.

Non solo tecnologia: siamo il partner che trasforma il modo in cui le imprese lavorano, crescono e competono. Dalla gestione delle risorse umane ai pagamenti digitali, dalla fatturazione elettronica alle relazioni con i clienti, progettiamo soluzioni su misura che entrano nel cuore dei processi aziendali, rendendoli più efficienti, più veloci e più intelligenti.

La nostra missione è semplice e allo stesso tempo ambiziosa: portare il valore del digitale in ogni impresa, qualunque sia la sua sfida. Lo facciamo mettendo il cliente al centro di tutto — non come slogan, ma come metodo di lavoro quotidiano.

La Business Unit PROFESSIONAL è protagonista della trasformazione digitale dei professionisti: commercialisti e consulenti del lavoro che scelgono di evolvere, non solo di adeguarsi.
Le nostre soluzioni integrate non si limitano a ottimizzare la gestione dello studio: la ridisegnano. Automatizziamo i processi, eliminiamo i vincoli operativi e innalziamo la qualità dei servizi che i professionisti offrono ai loro clienti ogni giorno.

Non ci fermiamo mai: investiamo continuamente nello sviluppo di nuove funzionalità e nell’integrazione con le tecnologie più avanzate, perché il mercato non aspetta — e il nostro compito è supportarlo.

La crescita di un’azienda non è mai un processo automatico. Si costruisce attraverso relazioni nuove, mercati inesplorati e fiducia conquistata nel tempo. In questo ruolo avrai una responsabilità precisa e strategica: allargare i confini del nostro ecosistema, portando al suo interno realtà che ancora non ci conoscono. Non è semplice vendita — è il lavoro che determina dove saremo domani.

Come BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT PARTNER, il tuo campo d’azione è il mercato dei professionisti: Commercialisti e Consulenti del lavoro. Ciò che ti distingue è la capacità di tenere insieme due qualità che raramente convivono: la tensione commerciale di chi misura il proprio successo in nuovi clienti acquisiti e la solidità di chi sa muoversi su trattative complesse con la giusta autorevolezza

Individuerai i prospect, costruirai accesso attraverso social selling, networking esecutivo e referral strategici. Saprai posizionare la nostra soluzione come un acceleratore di business e non come una voce di costo e condurrai ogni trattativa dalla prima discovery fino alla negoziazione finale.

Il tuo profilo:

  • Hai l’istinto di chi sa individuare un’opportunità prima che diventi evidente e la maturità di chi sa trasformarla in una relazione professionale solida;
  • I numeri ti descrivono meglio di qualsiasi titolo: hai un track record concreto nell’acquisizione di nuovi clienti, costruito con metodo e continuità;
  • Ti muovi con naturalezza nella costruzione di relazioni a livello di Professionisti, Partner di studi associati e Managing Director;
  • Il tuo percorso conta: hai almeno cinque anni di esperienza nel sales B2B, maturata nel mondo Software o nei servizi rivolti ai professionisti e-o aziende;
  • Conosci dall’interno i flussi di lavoro degli studi professionali e ciò ti permette di parlare la lingua del cliente prima ancora di iniziare la trattativa;

Un profilo solido si riconosce anche nel modo in cui una persona affronta l’incertezza, cresce attraverso il confronto e trasforma gli ostacoli in informazioni utili. Cerchiamo professionisti che riconoscano nei nostri valori qualcosa di già proprio — non una cultura nuova da imparare, ma un terreno familiare su cui continuare a crescere.

  • IMPRENDITORIALITÀ — Non è una caratteristica del ruolo, è una filosofia di lavoro. Significa vivere i propri obiettivi con responsabilità, osservare ogni situazione con spirito critico e mantenere il cliente come punto di riferimento costante. Chi la porta con sé non aspetta che le cose accadano: contribuisce a determinarle.
  • INNOVAZIONE — Le soluzioni più solide nascono dove esperienze diverse si incontrano e si sfidano. Lavoriamo in un contesto che considera l’errore parte del percorso, non un’interruzione. La vera innovazione non si pianifica a tavolino: si costruisce attraverso la libertà di esplorare.
  • INCLUSIONE — Ogni persona porta con sé una prospettiva unica. Creare le condizioni perché quella prospettiva emerga e conti non è solo una scelta etica: è ciò che rende un team capace di affrontare ciò che nessun individuo, da solo, potrebbe governare.

Cosa ti offriamo: ​

Crediamo che il rapporto con le nostre persone si fondi su fiducia, chiarezza degli obiettivi e piena autonomia su come raggiungerli. È da qui che nasce naturalmente il nostro approccio al lavoro e, di conseguenza, anche tutto ciò che lo accompagna: dal Light Friday — il venerdì pomeriggio non si lavora — ai benefit legati alla nostra way of working. ​

​

  • Retribuzione totale: € 54.000 – € 78.000 Comprensiva della componente variabile legata ai risultati. Riferimento full-time. ​

  • Wellbeing Digital Wallet: a partire da € 3850 annui Budget personale per il tuo benessere: viaggi, spese mediche, supporto alla genitorialità, sport e rimborsi per servizi alle persone come asilo nido, caregiver, etc… ​

  • Flessibilità: lavoriamo in modalità ibrida, con autonomia su quando essere in sede. Per noi la presenza ha senso quando migliora il lavoro: vieni quando il confronto con i colleghi fa la differenza, non per presenza ma per efficacia ​

  • Crescita: offriamo percorsi di formazione personalizzati e opportunità concrete di sviluppo in un gruppo internazionale in continua evoluzione ​

  • Ambiente: promuoviamo un contesto inclusivo, basato su fiducia, collaborazione e valorizzazione delle differenze ​

  • Impatto: lavoriamo ogni giorno per generare valore per persone, imprese e comunità attraverso il digitale

Patente B, necessaria per spostamenti e trasferte legate alle attività del ruolo

tags.title: Penn Medicine Clinician Department of Radiology at HUP
tags.description:
University Overview

The University of Pennsylvania, the largest private employer in Philadelphia, is a world-renowned leader in education, research, and innovation. This historic, Ivy League school consistently ranks among the top 10 universities in the annual U.S. News & World Report survey. Penn has 12 highly-regarded schools that provide opportunities for undergraduate, graduate and continuing education, all influenced by Penn’s distinctive interdisciplinary approach to scholarship and learning. As an employer Penn has been ranked nationally on many occasions with the most recent award from Forbes who named Penn one of America’s Best Large Employers in 2023.

Penn offers a unique working environment within the city of Philadelphia. The University is situated on a beautiful urban campus, with easy access to a range of educational, cultural, and recreational activities. With its historical significance and landmarks, lively cultural offerings, and wide variety of atmospheres, Philadelphia is the perfect place to call home for work and play.

The University offers a competitive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits, a wealth of health and wellness programs and resources, and much more.

Posted Job Title

Penn Medicine Clinician Department of Radiology at HUP

Job Profile Title

Penn Medicine Clinician

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Exciting opportunities are available at the Department of Radiology within the esteemed Perelman School of Medicine at the University of Pennsylvania! We are actively seeking board-certified radiologists to become part of our dynamic team at our downtown facilities, particularly at the Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania. We are specifically looking for general diagnostic radiologists with expertise in cardiothoracic or musculoskeletal imaging and procedures.

The Penn Medicine Clinician position provides health care services on a full-time or part-time basis and is integral to delivering exceptional healthcare services at Penn Medicine or The Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia. Your contributions will extend beyond patient care to include vital medico-administrative responsibilities, as you will be a valued member of the hospital’s medical staff. Additionally, the position may participate in a minimum of 50 hours per year of active and high-quality teaching or equivalent service.

We are dedicated to providing prompt, courteous, and highly skilled professional services that meet the highest standards. To apply, candidates must hold an unrestricted license to practice medicine in Pennsylvania or, if applicable, the location of their affiliated facilities. Interested candidates, we invite you to join us in making a meaningful impact on healthcare!

Qualifications
M.D.; License to practice medicine without restriction or limitation in Pennsylvania; DEA Licensure. 0-1 year of work experience of related experience in a specified medical field.

Working Conditions
Office, Library Computer Room; Requires extensive safety training; Requires protective devices

Physical Effort
Occasional lifting 24-50 lb.; Typically standing or walking; Intermittently sitting/standing/stooping; Using tools requiring high density; Typically bending, crouching, stooping

Job Location - City, State

Radnor, Pennsylvania

Penn Medicine Clinician

Department / School

Perelman School of Medicine

Pay Range

$20,000.00 - $400,000.00 Annual Rate

Salary offers are made based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and education as they directly relate to the requirements of the position, and in alignment with salary ranges based on external market data for the job’s level. Internal organization and peer data at Penn are also considered.

Equal Opportunity Statement

The University of Pennsylvania is an equal opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, religion, creed, national origin (including shared ancestry or ethnic characteristics), citizenship status, age, disability, veteran status or any class protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

Special Requirements
Background checks may be required after a conditional job offer is made. Consideration of the background check will be tailored to the requirements of the job.

University Benefits

  • Health, Life, and Flexible Spending Accounts: Penn offers comprehensive medical, prescription, behavioral health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits to protect you and your family’s health and welfare. You can also use flexible spending accounts to pay for eligible health care and dependent care expenses with pre-tax dollars.

  • Tuition: Take advantage of Penn's exceptional tuition benefits. You, your spouse, and your dependent children can get tuition assistance here at Penn. Your dependent children are also eligible for tuition assistance at other institutions.

  • Retirement: Penn offers generous retirement plans to help you save for your future. Penn’s Basic, Matching, and Supplemental retirement plans allow you to save for retirement on a pre-tax or Roth basis. Choose from a wide variety of investment options through TIAA and Vanguard.

  • Time Away from Work: Penn provides you with a substantial amount of time away from work during the course of the year. This allows you to relax, take vacations, attend to personal affairs, recover from illness or injury, spend time with family—whatever your personal needs may be.

  • Long-Term Care Insurance: In partnership with Genworth Financial, Penn offers faculty and staff (and your eligible family members) long-term care insurance to help you cover some of the costs of long-term care services received at home, in the community or in a nursing facility. If you apply when you’re newly hired, you won’t have to provide proof of good health or be subject to underwriting requirements. Eligible family members must always provide proof of good health and are subject to underwriting.

  • Wellness and Work-life Resources: Penn is committed to supporting our faculty and staff as they balance the competing demands of work and personal life. That’s why we offer a wide variety of programs and resources to help you care for your health, your family, and your work-life balance.

  • Professional and Personal Development: Penn provides an array of resources to help you advance yourself personally and professionally.

  • University Resources: As a member of the Penn community, you have access to a wide range of University resources as well as cultural and recreational activities. Take advantage of the University’s libraries and athletic facilities, or visit our arboretum and art galleries. There’s always something going on at Penn, whether it’s a new exhibit at the Penn Museum, the latest music or theater presentation at the Annenberg Center, or the Penn Relays at Franklin Field to name just a few examples. As a member of the Penn community, you’re right in the middle of the excitement—and you and your family can enjoy many of these activities for free.

  • Discounts and Special Services: From arts and entertainment to transportation and mortgages, you'll find great deals for University faculty and staff. Not only do Penn arts and cultural centers and museums offer free and discounted admission and memberships to faculty and staff. You can also enjoy substantial savings on other goods and services such as new cars from Ford and General Motors, cellular phone service plans, movie tickets, and admission to theme parks.

  • Flexible Work Hours: Flexible work options offer creative approaches for completing work while promoting balance between work and personal commitments. These approaches involve use of non-traditional work hours, locations, and/or job structures.

  • Penn Home Ownership Services: Penn offers a forgivable loan for eligible employees interested in buying a home or currently residing in West Philadelphia, which can be used for closing costs or home improvements.

  • Adoption Assistance: Penn will reimburse eligible employees on qualified expenses in connection with the legal adoption of an eligible child, such as travel or court fees, for up to two adoptions in your household.

​

To learn more, please visit: https://www.hr.upenn.edu/PennHR/benefits-pay

tags.title: Teaching Fellow - Health Science
tags.description:
Health Science Teaching Fellow | School of Health Science and Clinical Practice | Full-time | Torrens University Australia

Help shape the future of higher education.

At Torrens University Australia, we're redefining what learning looks like.

We're building a new cohort of Teaching Fellows - innovative, student-focused academics who are passionate about creating engaging learning experiences and helping shape the next generation of teaching and learning.

This is more than a teaching role. You'll join a team leading the evolution of higher education through student-centred learning, AI-enabled teaching, digital innovation, and contemporary learning design.

Why this role?

This role has been created to strengthen Torrens University’s permanent academic workforce, supporting the delivery of flexible, high-quality, student-centred learning experiences across on-campus, online, hybrid and asynchronous learning environments, while enhancing student success and employability.

We're looking for educators who don't simply teach, they innovate.

People who are excited by questions like:
• How can AI enhance learning?
• What does great online teaching look like?
• How can data and student feedback improve the learning experience?
• How do we prepare graduates for careers that don't yet exist?

About the role

As a Teaching Fellow (Health Science), you'll join the School of Health Science and Clinical Practice, where you'll deliver engaging learning experiences across the Diploma and Bachelor of Health Science programs delivering engaging learning experiences in subjects such as Understanding Health, Disease Prevention, Human Structure & Physiology 1 & 2.


You'll combine outstanding teaching practice with digital capability, learning design and innovation to create learning experiences that are flexible, engaging and centred around student success.

What you'll be doing - review Job description for full details

We're looking for educators who…

Put students first: You create inclusive, engaging learning experiences and genuinely care about helping every student succeed.
Embrace innovation: You're curious about new technologies, confident experimenting with AI and digital tools, and willing to rethink traditional approaches to teaching.
Use evidence to improve: You seek feedback, use learning analytics and continuously refine your teaching based on what works.
Collaborate: You enjoy working with colleagues across disciplines to improve learning, share ideas, and solve challenges together.
Thrive in change: You're adaptable, resilient, and excited by working in a dynamic, digitally evolving higher education environment.

Two full-time permanent positions: one based at our Flinders Street Campus in Melbourne and one at our Surry Hills Campus in Sydney.
Hybrid work arrangement: 3 days on campus and 2 days online (negotiable)

What you'll bring

  • MSc, PhD, or equivalent qualification in a relevant discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience in the healthcare sector, with the ability to apply industry knowledge to teaching and student learning.

  • Strong facilitation skills across online and face-to-face learning environments

  • Experience using learning technologies and digital tools to enhance teaching

  • Confidence using, or enthusiasm for adopting, AI-enabled approaches in education

  • Experience designing engaging learning and assessment activities

  • A student-centred approach to teaching and learning

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • A growth mindset and commitment to continuous professional learning

  • Relevant postgraduate qualifications (or working towards completion)

How to Apply - Our recruitment process is different

There is no prescribed format for your application. We encourage you to submit your application in the format that best showcases your experience, teaching philosophy and suitability for the role.

In addition to your CV, you may submit a short video, digital portfolio, presentation, personal website or another format that best represents you. Content matters more than creativity. We're interested in your teaching approach, impact, and capability—not production quality.
Recommended maximum length:
• Video: Up to 5 minutes
• Presentation or digital portfolio: Up to 5 slides/pages

Your application should demonstrate your teaching philosophy, student-centred approach, use of digital technologies and AI, innovation, continuous improvement, and the impact you've had on student outcomes.

Why join Torrens?

Join an institution committed to transforming education through innovation, technology and exceptional student experiences. You'll help shape the future of higher education while working alongside innovative educators committed to student success.

Applications close: 14th August 2026

We will be reviewing applications as they are received.

Application Process: Review > Interview(s) > Reference & Background Checks > Offer

Should you have accessibility requirements or needs please contact sebastian.pabon@torrens.edu.au for confidential support to ensure an equitable, barrier free application process as we have a Reasonable Adjustment Procedure in place to support you through the recruitment process.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete our application process, please contact our Human Resources Department at yourcareer@torrens.edu.au

tags.description:
We're hiring a hands-on PPC Lead to take full ownership of our paid acquisition. Emphasis on hands-on: you're in the accounts yourself — auditing, diagnosing, and buying media with your own hands — not managing people who do it for you.
We're in an active rebuild of the channel, so we need an operator, not an overseer: someone who spots what's underperforming without being asked, ships the fix, scales what works, and sees the next strategic move before it's obvious. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with our analysts and own the direction end-to-end.

🔥 What You'll Do
Own the accounts, hands-on. Personally audit and run buying across Google Ads and Meta first, then Bing, TikTok, Pinterest, and other networks as needed. You're in the accounts daily, not reading dashboards about them.
Find problems before we ask. Spot what's broken or leaking, call it out, and ship the fix — without waiting for direction.
Scale what works. Take winning campaigns from hand-bought to scaled, across channels and budgets.
Launch new products. Build acquisition engines for new tech products from scratch while scaling the core B2C offerings.
Co-own the data. Work directly with our analysts on raw data and the full user journey — write precise briefs for BI/data engineering (attribution, cohorts, custom conversions, server-side/CAPI) and use the output to drive real decisions.
Decide on real economics. Go past in-platform metrics — LTV, CAC, ROAS, cohort retention, true margin.
Test systematically. New channels, placements, bidding, audiences, landers, creative concepts.
Brief creative. Partner with design and copy on high-converting video/visual assets for TikTok, Meta, Pinterest.
Own the budget. Allocate and scale six-figure monthly spend for profit, not vanity reach.

✅ What We're Looking For
5+ years hands-on PPC / performance marketing, proven in B2C tech.
Actually hands-on. You buy media yourself, live in the accounts, and can walk into any account and diagnose it fast. Not someone who delegates and reports up.
Owns the direction. You build initiatives independently — no step-by-step guidance, no waiting to be assigned a problem.
Sees their own mistakes. Intellectual honesty over polish. You name what's not working — yours included — and fix it. No corporate talk.
Direct experience managing and scaling budgets of $200,000+/month with strong ROI/ROAS. (set to your real number)
Multi-platform depth: Google Ads, Meta, Bing, SA360, TikTok, Pinterest (programmatic/DSP a plus).
Raw-data mastery: works with raw data directly (SQL / BigQuery / Snowflake a strong advantage) and writes clear technical specs for analytics teams.
Strong B2C product sense: funnel optimization, subscriptions, app installs, or D2C digital products.
English B2+ (fluent written and spoken).

🎯 KPIs
CAC & ROAS — sustainable acquisition cost while scaling return on spend.
LTV / margin — scalable, profitable traffic with high long-term value.
Channel diversification — scaling TikTok, Meta, Networks, etc.
New launches — acquisition executed for new products from zero.

🌍 What We Offer
Full ownership & impact — complete autonomy over strategy, budget, and channels.
Tech-first, growth environment — high-potential products and new launches.
High-calibre team — direct work with product, data engineers, and creative.
Remote-first — flexible, trust and results over micromanagement.
Competitive comp & benefits — salary, performance bonuses, paid vacation, sick leave, health insurance.

tags.title: Communications Officer - Strategic Projects (Internal Applicants Only)
tags.description:
PLEASE NOTE THIS POST IS ONLY OPEN TO INTERNAL APPLICANTS

Oganisation: Leicestershire County Council

Work Location: County Hall, Glenfield, Leicester, LE3 8RA

Salary: £39,939 to £42,699 per annum (pro- rata for part-time) (Pay award pending)

Working Hours: 22.2 hours per week

Contract Type: Fixed term until December 2029

Closing Date: Sunday 2 August 2026

Interview Date(s): 10th & 11th August 2026

We're looking for an experienced communications professional to help plan and deliver effective campaigns that focus on the council's strategic projects.

About the Role

We'll need you to produce, implement and project manage a wide range of external and internal communications strategies to support the council’s priorities, working closely with Communications Officers, Designers and the Digital Team to develop and implement integrated communication strategies. You'll be co-ordinating the work of the Communications Officers and designing and presenting campaign proposals to members and officers in a persuasive and effective manner and provides sound communications advice.

This post is politically restricted therefore the postholder is disqualified from undertaking certain political activities under the Local Government Officers (Political Restrictions) Regulations 1990.

About You

To apply for this post, you must be able to evidence in your application how you meet the following criteria:

We are looking for someone who has:

  • Relevant education or experience – degree-level qualification or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Campaign experience – is able to design, deliver and evaluate effective communications campaigns to a wide range of audiences
  • Creative and production knowledge – experience of creative development and producing communications materials.
  • Event delivery experience – planning, developing and delivering events.
  • Research and evaluation skills – using market research and interpreting evidence to shape communications.
  • Worked in a large or complex organisation – proven ability to deliver communications in a large or complex organisation.
  • The ability to prioritise – can manage workload, competing demands and conflicting pressures.
  • Strategy and supervision experience – developing strategies/implementation plans and supervising staff.

One of the projects the successful candidate will work on is HDRC (Health Determinants Research Collaboration). The successful candidate will need to get up to speed quickly with a complex project that has a wide range of audiences and stakeholders. Experience of communicating on this type of project would be beneficial.

In addition, we also expect you to share our commitment to our values and to delivering accessible and inclusive services which meet the needs of all of our residents. You will be asked to demonstrate your understanding of these commitments as part of the selection process.

Reasonable adjustments will be considered for applicants with a disability. We are a Disability Confident Employer.

Interested in Flexible Working?

We are open to discussions about flexible working, which may include part time working, job sharing, term-time working, flexible start and finish times, and hybrid working, depending on the requirements of the role and the service. If you would like to discuss the possible flexible working options that might be applicable to this role, please contact the person named below.

For more information or an informal discussion, please contact:

Liz Goodman, Strategic Communications Manager (Campaigns), 0116 305 8341, liz.goodman@leics.gov.uk

For more information on HDRC, see: https://resources.leicestershire.gov.uk/health-and-wellbeing/nihr-health-determinants-research-collaboration-leicestershire/about-hdrc-leicestershire

How to Apply

At Leicestershire County Council we’re looking for top talent from all walks of life. Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, and whatever your background - we care about what you bring to our organisation, not just what’s on your CV. That’s why we’ve designed a recruitment process that’s fair, accessible, and focused on potential. And with benefits that support people at every age and stage of life, we make sure you can thrive - both personally and professionally.

If you share our passion to make a difference for the people of Leicestershire, we’d love to hear from you. Click the apply button to submit your application, ensuring that you upload a supporting statement that explains how you meet the criteria listed in the ‘About You’ section above. Without this information, we won’t be able to assess your suitability for the role, and your application will be rejected. For tips on how to write your statement, see the How to Apply section on our career site.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible.

If you have any technical issues when trying to apply for this post or you want to request an application pack in an alternative format, please contact our Employee Service Centre by telephoning 0300 3030222 (select option 2) or raising a ticket via our online portal: https://emss.org.uk/support.

By applying for this post, you agree to our Terms and Conditions.

En varevognschauffør med salgs- og repræsentationsopgaver, ofte kendt som en Route Sales Representative (RSR), har en unik rolle, der kombinerer kørsel, kundeservice og salg. Det er meget mere end bare at levere varer; det handler om at være virksomhedens ansigt ude i marken og aktivt vokse sin egen rute.

Kerneopgaven er at betjene ruten sikkert og effektivt. Det indebærer:

• Sikker kørsel: At betjene firmabilen sikkert og følge alle færdselsregler samt udføre daglige eftersyn af køretøjet.

• Planlægning og levering: At planlægge ruten for at optimere tiden og sikre, at alle leveringer sker til tiden. Dette inkluderer at læsse og losse varer korrekt.

• Eksponering og rådgivning: Sørge for korrekt opsætning og eksponering af produkter hos kunderne og demonstrere produkternes værdi

Kombinationen af selvstændigt kørselsarbejde og et klart fokus på at sælge og udvikle forretningen gør denne rolle til et godt match for personer, der både er servicemindede og salgsorienterede.

tags.location: Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul, Brasil
tags.description:
Nós da Saque, somos muito mais do que caixas eletrônicos! Com presença internacional, criamos soluções inteligentes para as necessidades do cotidiano, trazendo mais acesso aos serviços que você mais precisa.

Trabalhar com um propósito ousado, em um ambiente inovador e em constante transformação te chama atenção? Então dá uma olhada nesta oportunidade que a Saque tem para você!

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como Analista Comercial I, com foco no desenvolvimento e fortalecimento do relacionamento com a conta Aletha Multivarejo, promovendo a utilização dos ATMs instalados, capacitando clientes, identificando oportunidades comerciais e ampliando a presença da empresa por meio da prospecção de novos negócios.

Essa posição faz parte da diretoria comercial, e terá interface com áreas como Comercial, Operações, Marketing, Produtos, Financeiro, Cadastro e Contratos, Atendimento/SAC e Tecnologia.

Buscamos alguém que se identifique com uma cultura colaborativa, orientada a resultados, simplicidade, aprendizado contínuo e foco no cliente. Valorizamos pessoas que pensem e ajam como donas do negócio, sejam protagonistas, descomplicadas, colaborativas e focadas em gerar valor para clientes e parceiros.

Você fará parte de um time que atua diretamente no campo, próximo aos clientes e usuários dos serviços, contribuindo para a expansão da utilização das soluções da Aletha, o fortalecimento dos relacionamentos comerciais e a geração de novas oportunidades de negócios.

  • Desenvolver e fortalecer o relacionamento com clientes sob sua responsabilidade, realizando contatos ativos, visitas presenciais e acompanhamentos periódicos para estimular o uso dos produtos e serviços da empresa.
  • Prospectar novos clientes e identificar oportunidades de negócio no entorno dos pontos de atendimento e da base instalada, ampliando a presença comercial da empresa e contribuindo para o crescimento da carteira.
  • Apresentar soluções, produtos e serviços aos clientes, identificando necessidades, esclarecendo dúvidas e apoiando a geração de novas oportunidades comerciais.
  • Realizar treinamentos presenciais e remotos sobre os produtos e serviços disponibilizados pela empresa, garantindo a correta utilização das soluções e promovendo a melhor experiência do cliente.
  • Acompanhar os indicadores de utilização da carteira, identificando oportunidades de aumento de adesão, recorrência e engajamento dos clientes.
  • Receber, registrar e acompanhar demandas de clientes e parceiros comerciais, assegurando o direcionamento adequado e o acompanhamento até a conclusão das tratativas.
  • Apoiar clientes durante o processo de ativação, utilização e expansão dos serviços contratados, atuando como facilitador entre as áreas internas e os usuários.
  • Identificar oportunidades de cross-selling e upselling, promovendo produtos complementares e soluções financeiras aderentes ao perfil e à necessidade dos clientes.
  • Captar, validar e organizar documentações necessárias para cadastro, abertura de contas e contratação de produtos, garantindo conformidade com os processos internos.
  • Registrar interações, visitas, treinamentos, oportunidades, negociações e encaminhamentos nos sistemas corporativos e ferramentas de CRM, mantendo as informações atualizadas e confiáveis.
  • Atuar em parceria com as áreas de Comercial, Operações, Marketing, Produtos, Financeiro, Jurídico, Cadastro e Atendimento, contribuindo para a evolução dos negócios e para a satisfação dos clientes.



Experiências Esperadas

  • Experiência em vendas externas, prospecção ativa de clientes (hunter), desenvolvimento de mercado ou expansão comercial.
  • Vivência em rotinas de visitas presenciais, atuação em campo e gestão de carteira de clientes.
  • Experiência na geração de novos negócios por meio de prospecção porta a porta, indicações, networking ou abordagens consultivas.
  • Vivência com negociação comercial, apresentação de produtos e condução de oportunidades até o fechamento.
  • Capacidade de acompanhar metas, indicadores de produtividade comercial e resultados de vendas.
  • Experiência com registro e gestão de oportunidades em CRM ou sistemas comerciais.
  • Experiência em relacionamento com clientes, identificando oportunidades de expansão, retenção e crescimento da carteira.


Experiências Desejáveis

  • Experiência em empresas dos segmentos de bens de consumo, telecomunicações, meios de pagamento, serviços financeiros, adquirência ou varejo.
  • Vivência em atividades de prospecção ativa, desenvolvimento de mercado e expansão de carteira de clientes.
  • Experiência na abertura de novas oportunidades de negócio, atuação em campo e expansão territorial.
  • Vivência no atendimento e desenvolvimento de pequenos e médios varejistas.
  • Familiaridade com indicadores comerciais, gestão de funil de vendas, produtividade de visitas e conversão de oportunidades.
  • Experiência com treinamento de clientes, ativação de produtos e incentivo à utilização de serviços.
  • Atuação em ambientes orientados por metas, indicadores e acompanhamento contínuo de performance e resultados




Na Saque, você é livre para ser quem é! Aqui, todos nós valorizamos e acreditamos que somos iguais na diferença! Prezamos por um ambiente seguro e inclusivo com foco nas pessoas. Acreditamos que a inovação se faz com diferentes olhares, SOMOS UM!


Vem mostrar sua atitude, vem transformar relações com a gente!
